episodes.name: One Night Stand Episode 1
episodes.overview:
Khwanphon, a modern high school teacher, doesn't believe in long-term relationships or even love. She leads a secret lifestyle, enjoying one-night stands without any commitments. However, she finds herself involved with three different men: Kornkit, a gentlemanly figure who is the son of the school owner where Khwanphon works; Time, a colleague who has been pursuing her for a long time but has never been reciprocated; and Mac, a playboy who desires more than just one-night stands with Khwanphon.

The story becomes complicated when Khwanphon decides to marry one of the three men. However, her turbulent past catches up with her, leading to unexpected consequences.

episodes.name: Depression or Just Selfishness Episode 1
episodes.overview: He’s well aware of my illness, yet he endures it. He consistently takes great care of me, but I find myself continually digging up his past to hurt him. The more he remains silent, the worse my condition becomes. At times, I’ve even told him I wanted to harm myself just to instill fear in him. I resist seeking treatment because I believe that by remaining in this state, he will stay with me, never leaving my side. That’s why I persist in behaving in ways that cause him worry. I understand the situation, but I still can’t fathom why I act this way.

episodes.overview: Adults often teach children that love should come at the right time, when they're ready to take on responsibilities and face life's challenges. But in today's world, many young people find themselves on a troubled path, struggling with the consequences of their actions. Adults may have their reasons for this, but ultimately, it's the children who suffer. This story highlights the harsh reality faced by these children, who want to remind adults that their problems are real and deserve attention. Love, no matter when it happens, is a beautiful thing, especially when it occurs during times of hardship and confusion.

episodes.overview:
In the era of social media, everyone can freely express their opinions about others. They can use harsh words without much consideration, not thinking about the consequences or verifying the truth.

In a relationship between two women, one becomes overly concerned with the opinions of others, making her vulnerable to someone she doesn't know who ends up hurting her. The second woman has never cared much, firmly believing in the adage "to each their own." However, at times, she can be remarkably oblivious to the feelings of those around her.

With their love in the spotlight, eyes across the nation scrutinise their every move, passing judgement on ever action.

candidates.name: 16 and Pregnant
candidates.overview: This hourlong documentary series focuses on the issue of teen pregnancy, with each episode detailing the wide variety of challenges -- marriage, adoption, finances, gossip and graduating high school among them — a pregnant teenager faces while still coming of age.

episodes.name: Maci
episodes.overview: Before she found out she was pregnant, Maci was the classic overachiever from Chattanooga, Tennessee. When her fiance Ryan takes no interest in helping out with the new baby, Maci has to try to salvage her relationship.

episodes.name: Farrah
episodes.overview: Farrah is a popular cheerleader from Council Bluffs, Iowa. When her friends start gossiping about her becoming a single mom, she abandons her high school life and starts spending way too much time with her overbearing mother.

episodes.name: Amber
episodes.overview: Amber never imagined she'd spend her senior year moving in with her well meaning, but immature, boyfriend Gary. But with a baby on the way, the two will have to juggle adult responsibilities on a teenage budget.

episodes.name: Ebony
episodes.overview: A military brat from Colorado Springs, Ebony and her boyfriend Josh plan to join the Air Force after senior year. But the responsibilities of a new baby may keep them from enlisting, and maybe even from graduating.

episodes.name: Whitney
episodes.overview: A southern belle from small town Georgia, Whitney is definitely the baby of the family. But with her mom pregnant as well, the house gets too crowded, and Whitney and her boyfriend must figure out how to move out.

episodes.name: Catelynn
episodes.overview: 16 year-old Catelynn is the voice of reason in an otherwise hot-tempered family. With the support of her boyfriend Tyler, she's taking the biggest stand of her life and pursuing adoption without the approval of her parents.

episodes.name: Life Afer Labour
episodes.overview: Dr. Drew sits down with the Cast of Season 1 to discuss each girl's episode, specific issues and challenges and update us on what's going on now.

candidates.name: Pregnant at 16
candidates.overview:
According to the Ministry of Health in Russia, there are 800 underage girls per 100,000 pregnant women. Most of them decide to keep the child, and this decision radically changes their lives: now they are not just teenage girls, they are young mothers.

In each episode, we will get acquainted with the story of one heroine: how it happened that she became pregnant, how her parents and future father will perceive the news about the child, how her life will change after childbirth and how she will solve adult problems at such a tender age.

Will the girls find the strength to overcome the trials and find happiness?
16+ is a Belgian-Flemish youth drama TV series that aired from 2005 to 2008 across 40 episodes

Teenagers are getting raped. A gang who calls themselves 16 is hurting seemingly innocent people. Police want to hunt the rapist. They also want to stop the vigilantes who have chosen to take the law into their hands.

episodes.name: An Unexpected Event
episodes.overview: Neel and Minni battle it out whether Annu committed suicide or was she murdered. But an unexpected event in the middle of a party bewilders everyone on what's going on more so on what's going to happen in the future ...

episodes.name: The Attack

episodes.name: A Doubtful Dart
episodes.overview: Neel and Minni try to figure out who could be part of a group of vigilante. The vigilantes seem close to getting their target. But is their assumption correct?

episodes.name: A Painful Incident

episodes.name: A Common Motto

episodes.name: A Set Up

episodes.name: A Lead

episodes.name: Who Catches The Culprit?

episodes.name: The Monsters Prey

candidates.overview: "16+" centers on a group of four friends – Māra, Mārtiņš, Edgars, and Pauls, who study in the same class. As the new school year begins, two girls – Laura and Amanda – join the class, whose arrival and attitude shake up the seemingly stable friendship. A series of events begins, in which everyone is drawn into it, and it is clear that no one will get out of it easily.

episodes.name: 1. SĒRIJA
episodes.overview: Edgars leaves Māra. Next week, the school inauguration event is being prepared, for which Māra is responsible. Paul is supposed to give a speech, but at the most important moment, Paul has disappeared.

episodes.name: 2. SĒRIJA
episodes.overview: Māra's incoherent speech is interrupted by Amanda and Laura's show. Māra is shocked. Later, on a class evening, Māra is quite drunk and responds to Amanda's provocations with her trainer's whip, hitting her in the cheek. Laura has filmed the whole thing. Edgars takes Laura home, but Māra wanders alone along the tracks at night and sends Edgar desperate messages. The next morning, Amanda meets Laura and prepares plans for revenge against Māra and her company.

episodes.name: 3. SĒRIJA
episodes.overview: Māra meets with her friends, and everyone realizes what trouble is looming because of the video Laura made. Amanda demands money from everyone and an interesting performance from the guys so that the company can atone for its guilt. Pauls wants to help Māra, but Edgars and Mārtiņš resist. Māra's mother, Gita, starts a conversation with Māra, but Māra is too absorbed in her own problems and doesn't understand anything her mother says.

episodes.name: 4. SĒRIJA
episodes.overview: Māra names Paul and persuades him to make an important announcement during a sex education lecture. Mārtiņš meets Paul at school, the two almost fight, and Paul tries to run away from him. Māra does not expect Paul during the lecture and tries to give the speech herself. Māra has an argument with her mother. A man tries to get to know Māra in the stairwell, and she perceives it as sexual harassment.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: Paul returns to school after an accident. Edgar's birthday is approaching, and Laura has also been invited to the celebration. Māra is not thrilled about it. Amanda's friend Gatis gives Laura a valuable gift and gives both girls a dangerous task. Mārtiņš buys grass from Gatis. When Māra arrives at Edgar's birthday party, she does not feel welcome there. Laura and Amanda try to complete Gatis' task, but they are interrupted and seen. Amanda acts inappropriately in a stressful situation.

episodes.name: 7. SĒRIJA
episodes.overview: Gatis and Amanda threaten Mārtiņš. Gatis attacks Amanda. Mārtiņš, Pauls and Edgars meet and each has their problems. Māra wakes up after a big party and meets Anna. Māra cannot remember the events of the previous night.

episodes.name: 8. SĒRIJA
episodes.overview: Laura and Amanda argue about the computer. Amanda posts part of the video from the dedication night. Paul defends Māra. Anna talks about the night Māra spent with Garo. The neighborhood children come to Anna's place. Laura meets with Mārtiņš to find out the truth about what happened together.

episodes.name: 9. SĒRIJA
episodes.overview: Laura meets Amanda and Gati. Pauls meets Māra's desperate mother. Mārtiņš tries to persuade Edgar to listen to Laura. Paul tries to persuade his friends to help look for Māra. Laura comes to Edgars, but Edgars doesn't want to talk to her. Anna is having another party.

episodes.name: 10. SĒRIJA
episodes.overview: Edgars meets Mārtiņš, and their conflict only deepens. Māra meets Paula, who is offended and jealous. Laura records Amanda's story about what Gatis is doing. Amanda runs away from Gatis. Laura talks Amanda into staying with Mārtiņš.

episodes.name: 11. SĒRIJA
episodes.overview: Mara reconciles with her mother. Laura offers to help Mara. Gati is arrested. A party is organized.

1.name: Season 1
1.overview: "16+" centers on a group of four friends – Māra, Mārtiņš, Edgars, and Pauls, who study in the same class. As the new school year begins, two girls – Laura and Amanda – join the class, whose arrival and attitude shake up the seemingly stable friendship. A series of events begins, in which everyone is drawn into it, and no one will get out of it easily.

candidates.name: James at 16
candidates.overview: James at 15 (later James at 16) is an American drama series that aired on NBC during the 1977–1978 season. Protagonist James Hunter is the son of a college professor who has moved his family across the country to take a teaching job, transplanting James from Oregon to Boston, Massachusetts. James has a hard time fitting into his new surroundings.

episodes.name: James at 15
episodes.overview: A 15-year-old whose family moves from Oregon to Boston misses the girlfriend he left behind, so he runs away to see her. On the way he hooks up with a female art student in her 20s who is also hitchhiking across the country, from whom he learns some valuable lessons about life.

episodes.name: Friends
episodes.overview: James throws a party to make new friends -- among them, Sly and Marlene.

episodes.name: The Girl with the Bad Rep
episodes.overview: When even the girl with the bad rep turns down James, he brags to Sly that they made out anyway.

episodes.name: Kathy's in the Shower
episodes.overview: Kathy is caught having a secret affair with her professor.

episodes.name: Higher Ground
episodes.overview: James joins a cult.

episodes.name: The Apple Tree, the Singing and the Gold
episodes.overview: Bobby, James' old friend back home in Oregon, comes to Boston because he needs to have some medical tests done.  James's new friend, Patricia, finds herself falling in love with Bobby, who turns out to be fatally ill.

episodes.name: Fast and Loose
episodes.overview: James' fast and loose new friend leads him to commit a crime.

episodes.name: Mrs. Carson
episodes.overview: James is hot for teacher, who happens to be pregnant.

episodes.name: Unrequited Love... Twice
episodes.overview: James is pursued romantically by both Sandy's friend and one of Paul's students.

episodes.name: Actions Speak Louder
episodes.overview: James befriends a deaf classmate, and puts himself in his shoes.

episodes.name: Star-Crossed Lovers
episodes.overview: Marlene develops a crush on a rock star.

episodes.name: The Gift
episodes.overview: James loses his virginity to a Swedish foreign exchange student and turns 16.

episodes.name: The Blowout
episodes.overview: James is uncomfortable at a Valentine's Day party.

episodes.name: Listless Fever
episodes.overview: James fears that Gun may have given him a little something ""extra.""

episodes.name: Champions
episodes.overview: Marlene's all-girls basketball team challenges James' all-boys basketball team to a championship.

episodes.name: An Hour Before Midnight
episodes.overview: James's classmate, who edits his school paper, has a drinking problem. James works with a teenage reporter who declares that she is an alcoholic, fluffs an important Interview with a Pulitzer Prize winner and arrives drunk when invited to dinner at the Hunters.

episodes.name: Knocking Heads
episodes.overview: James and a teacher knock heads over James' controversial football articles in the school paper.

episodes.name: Rebel Without a Car

episodes.name: Queen of the Silver Dollar

candidates.name: C-16: FBI
candidates.overview: ​This series revolves around the Los Angeles field office of the FBI that was assigned to the most difficult cases.

episodes.name: Pilot (1)
episodes.overview: The son of controversial district attorney Catherine Hampton is kidnapped and the C-16 is called into action. Rookie agents Mal Robinson and Amanda Reardon get a good chance to prove themselves.

episodes.name: Pilot (2)
episodes.overview: The hunt for Catherine Hampton's kidnapped son continues. The time is starting to run out...

episodes.name: Radio FBI
episodes.overview: A famous radio host is held hostage at the radio station by an unbalanced man who threatens to detonate a bomb. Olanksy is assigned to mediate.

episodes.name: The Sandman
episodes.overview: The Sandman, a famous assassin, arrives in town to make a hit at an important conference. Annie must try to stop him but the she has no idea who the intended target could be.

episodes.name: Orange Kid
episodes.overview: The team investigates a series of bank robberies which appear to be committed by teenagers. Meanwhile, former undercover agent Nick Tulli has difficulties adjusting to the real world again, and Amanda is assigned to help him.

episodes.name: Eight Pounds of Pressure
episodes.overview: The C-16 team pursue a band of traffickers. Di Rado infiltrates the band in an attmept to stop a money laundring operation.

episodes.name: Russian Winter
episodes.overview: Nick Tulli is murdered and Olanksy gets his hands full trying to solve the case.

episodes.name: The Art of War
episodes.overview: The C-16 team receive news of a bomb threat at the Los Angeles airport. Robinson and Stoddard must take on the dangerous assignment.

episodes.name: My Brother's Keeper
episodes.overview: The team make a raid on during a heroin delivery at a warehouse but things are complicated due to the fact that Robinson's brother is involved in the drug deal. Meanwhile, Annie's ex-husband is making the custody battle extremely hard for her.

episodes.name: Green Card
episodes.overview: Stoddard tries to dismantle an international network of prostitution. He is helped by Rita, a beautiful girl who knows the names of the people implied in this illegal traffic. But Rita wants something in return...

episodes.name: Russian Roulette
episodes.overview: Lutzhin, the thug presumed responsible for Nick Tulli's death, is out of jail and Olansky is determined to nail hilm. With the help of Tulli's guilt-wrecked ex-mistress Laura, Olanksy sets a trap.

episodes.name: El Nino
episodes.overview: Former mobster Tommy LoBianco is brought to the C-16 base to discuss his impending testimony in a mafia trial. In the middle of this, a terrible blizzard strikes.

episodes.name: Hitting Olansky
episodes.overview: Olanksy barely escapes an attempt on his life. Powerful mobster Harry Negretti appears to be behind it, and Olanksy gets into a conflict with his worried 17 year-old daughter when he insists on going after Negretti.

candidates.name: AIKa R-16 Virgin Mission
candidates.overview: Aika is a skilled but impulsive high school student who earns a C-class salvager license yet struggles to find work due to her age and reputation. After advertising her services at school, she is hired by Erika, a wealthy student and leader of the Treasure Hunting Club. What begins as a simple salvage job quickly turns dangerous, leading Aika into a high-stakes mission, a clash in the southern islands, and the mystery surrounding a girl named Karen.

episodes.name: Trial 1: Secret Game
episodes.overview: Aika Sumeragi, a high school age C-Class salvager, is hired by class president Eri Shinkai to pilot her salvaging vessel. After introducing Aika to the treasure hunting club, and revealing coordinates hidden in a marking on fellow classmate Karen Minamino's chest, they embark on an adventure to see where it leads.

episodes.name: Trial 2: Peach Peach Beach
episodes.overview: After arriving at the coordinates, Eri decides the treasure hunting club needs a break and declares that they will have a beach party on a nearby island. They are not alone, however, and Aika has to fight her teacher to protect Karen.

episodes.name: Trial 3: Deep Blue Girl
episodes.overview: In the final episode of the series, Aika, Eri, and Karen find an old airport at the bottom of the ocean. After exploring the still functional facility, they finally uncover the secret to Karen's past.

candidates.name: My Super Sweet 16
candidates.overview: My Super Sweet 16 is a MTV reality series documenting the lives of teenagers, usually in the United States, Canada and UK, who usually have wealthy parents who throw huge coming of age celebrations. Parties include the quinceañera, the sweet 16, and other birthdays including a My Super Sweet 21 and My Super Swag 18.

episodes.name: Jacqueline & Lauren
episodes.overview: Lauren and Jackie, two La Jolla, CA, teens are planning a joint "coming-of-age" party at the Hard Rock Cafe.

episodes.name: Jacque
episodes.overview: Jacque is a self-described nerd who has dreamed of her Sweet 16 forever.

episodes.name: Ava
episodes.overview: 15-year-old Ava gears up for her "Arabian Nights"-themed sweet 16.

episodes.name: Hart
episodes.overview: Hart is a 16 year old boy who wants to show that Sweet 16's aren't just for girls.

episodes.name: Natalie
episodes.overview: Natalie has just moved from sleepy Roswell, NM to live with her dad and his new fiance in glamorous La Jolla, CA.

episodes.name: Sierra
episodes.overview: The party is almost called off due to a poor report card. Sierra makes her entrance walking into the party's fashion show. Sierra was the stepdaughter of musician Cee Lo Green at the time of this episode.

candidates.name: Torn Apart
candidates.overview: Aras, a fearless seventeen-year-old boy, comes to Bodrum to search for his younger sibling, the only remaining member of his family whom he lost at the age of five. His new life in Bodrum will turn into a challenging struggle when his path crosses with the Akkaya family, the most powerful family in the city.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: Aras is a young man who lost his family in a traffic accident when he was very young and grew up in an orphanage. He has been searching for his brother for years, whom he learned survived the accident and was adopted by a family. He receives an anonymous tip about his brother's whereabouts and sets off for Bodrum. Upon arriving there, his path will cross with the Akkaya family, the most powerful family in Bodrum. Enrolled in the Bodrum Education Foundation High School, owned by the Akkaya family, Aras will face great challenges on his quest to find his brother, forging both lasting friendships and enmities from the very beginning. However, he will soon learn, in a painful way, that reaching his brother will not be so easy.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: As Aras collapses to the ground wounded by Teoman, he notices the crow tattoo on Teoman's arm and believes he might be the brother he's been searching for all these years. Teoman's wounding of Aras is a shock to the Akkaya family, and Şebnem Akkaya is determined not to give up her son. Meanwhile, Hakan Akkaya learns Aras's true identity. What started as a difficult test for Aras in Bodrum will become even harder, and Hakan, the most powerful man in the city, will do everything in his power to prevent the two brothers from reuniting, due to his dark past that he must conceal. However, Hakan's efforts to distance Aras are thwarted by Teoman's furious actions towards Aras, unexpectedly bringing the two brothers face to face.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: Aras, upon arriving at the address to reunite with his brother, finds Teoman there. Teoman possesses surprising information about Aras's past. Intense emotional moments will unfold between Aras and Teoman, leaving their mark on both of them. Meanwhile, Aras is a fugitive in Bodrum. Before leaving, he needs to reach the man who sent him messages promising to hand over his brother. As he fails to reach the man, his time and resources in Bodrum are running out. For Aras to remain there, Leyla will take a gamble against her family. However, this gamble will ultimately cost Leyla dearly.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: The boat Aras and Teoman are on has started to drift in the middle of the sea, and as Teoman's eyes close, it seems like he recalls a memory. This memory will later prompt him to ask questions. Meanwhile, Aras, not content with staying on the burning boat, will be taken into custody due to Şebnem's complaint, and a surprise name will rescue him from there. Afterward, Aras will pursue the newspaper in Teoman's possession. As a result of the trail he follows, he gets one step closer to his sibling, while Teoman, having set out on this path with the words “I will find your sibling before you do,” will find himself questioning his past.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: Aras's world crumbles when a piece of bad news shatters his hopes after he finds a lead about his brother. Unaware of Aras's situation, Teoman does something that deeply hurts him, escalating their relationship into an unprecedented conflict. Witnessing this, Leyla initially confronts Aras, but later tries to understand him. However, Aras no longer has the energy to explain himself to anyone. This causes Leyla to distance herself from him. Just when Aras thinks he's lost everything and is about to get into trouble, Teoman appears. Their relationship becomes entangled in a difficult-to-define situation once again. When Aras receives news that gives him renewed hope, he must first win back the hearts of those he hurt in his search for his brother. Meanwhile, Teoman suspects a connection between Aras and Serhat. Following Serhat's trail will lead him to another surprise.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: Aras realizes that Demir is hiding from him for some reason when he finds the journalist's office—who had lied about his brother's death—completely empty. When he connects the small clues, he will begin to suspect Serhat as the person sending the messages. Meanwhile, Teoman has found the phone Serhat used to talk to Aras and, upon calling the only saved number, hears Aras's voice on the other end. Thinking that Serhat and Aras are up to something, Teoman will head that way; however, he won't escape Hakan's wrath. Teoman's constant proximity to Aras is causing the curtain of the past to lift from time to time for him. When Şebnem learns who Aras is, she will have to take harsher measures alongside her husband. But, contrary to their expectations, this measure will once again bring Teoman and Aras together. Moreover, this time, Leyla is right at the center of everything that's happening.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: Serhat, realizing he’s about to be exposed, has sat down at the bargaining table with Hakan based on what he knows and gotten what he wanted. Aras, upon learning who he is, has kidnapped Serhat along with Metin to find out his brother’s whereabouts. Just as Aras gets this close to his brother, Serhat’s attempt to escape causes an accident. Finding his brother becomes a bit more difficult for Aras. Hakan’s mistake in trying to eliminate Serhat will lead Aras to the Akkaya villa. The person who helps Aras enter the villa will be Leyla, who is fed up with the pressures from her family, especially her mother. Meanwhile, Deniz being left without a dress due to dirty water flooding their home will cause the paths of Teoman and Deniz to cross.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: Aras and Leyla have started playing the role of lovers, arriving hand in hand at the fashion show held at the Akkaya mansion for the benefit of orphaned children. However, Aras being assaulted by Teoman there causes a major scandal for the Akkaya Family. For this reason, the Akkayas find themselves forced to ask for Aras's help. With his acceptance of helping, the danger of his past secret coming to light emerges. Yet the real great danger is approaching Aras. Meanwhile, Teoman embarks on a new and dangerous game to hurt Aras, whom he couldn't bring to his senses through fighting. And in the end, this game will hurt him the most, though he hasn't realized it yet.

episodes.name: Episode 9
episodes.overview: The news that the dormitory will be closed turns Aras and his friends' lives upside down. Aras finds himself torn between the most important search of his life and his friends' futures. Aras and his friends, refusing to leave the dormitory, decide to spend the night in the dormitory's garden. In this struggle of Aras, his biggest supporters will be Barış and Özlem. However, an unexpected name joins this event: Teoman. Teoman finds himself in the midst of a tension he never anticipated. This tension will cause Teoman to lose control over his suppressed emotions. Leyla becomes the target of the dormitory children's anger. The children, blaming the Akkayalar for what happened to Aras, don't want to let Leyla into their midst. Aras tries to keep Leyla away from himself to protect her. Every step Aras takes to protect her will only deepen Leyla's resentment toward Aras. Right at that moment, a sentence that Leyla overhears will change all the balances regarding Aras's true feelings.

episodes.name: Episode 10
episodes.overview: Aras, thanks to Teoman, managed to reach Serhat, the only person who knew his brother Demir's whereabouts. However, before he could get any information, Hakan Akkaya took him away. Aras now has only one option: to infiltrate the Akkaya Villa. But this attempt leads to another major conflict with the Akkaya family, and puts him and Leyla on the brink of a difficult path from which there is no return. Leyla questions her trust in Aras for the first time. Aras faces a difficult choice between his love and the well-being of those he loves. Leyla, however, is more determined than ever. She pushes him to the limit to be sure of both his feelings and his words. She wants to learn the big secret Aras has been hiding from her from the beginning. But this path leads to a dangerous place for both of them.

episodes.name: Episode 11
episodes.overview: As everyone grapples with their own wounds after the accident, the shadow of the past falls once again upon the Akkaya family. Teoman, believing his father is hiding a great secret from him, sets out to uncover shocking clues about his past. Aras tries to decipher the meaning behind a mysterious word Serhat painstakingly utters, and finds a new way to reach his brother. The trust between Leyla and Aras is tested. The arrival of Doğukan, the son of the Akkaya family's friend, heralds a new era that will shift the balance. The cracks within the Akkaya family deepen. Hidden truths come closer to the surface. Unaware of each other's paths, Aras and Teoman unexpectedly cross in the same place, bearing the scars of the past.

episodes.name: Episode 12
episodes.overview: Aras, after years of searching for his brother, finds renewed hope thanks to a tiny clue left behind. Reaching the place where Demir once lived brings him closer to his brother. This leads him to increasingly difficult questions. Is it a coincidence that all paths lead to the same people, or is someone trying to hide a much bigger truth from Aras?

episodes.name: Episode 13
episodes.overview: Aras becomes increasingly involved in a dangerous game to uncover Demir's past. He struggles, hoping to find the answers he seeks in psychologist records that have been hidden for years. The obstacles he encounters will confront him with both the passage of time and insurmountable difficulties.Teoman, with Leyla's support, tries to bear the burden of the past. He falls under the influence of the new world Hakan has opened up for him. Meanwhile, Aras and Leyla will drift further apart due to Doğukan's actions.

episodes.name: Episode 14
episodes.overview: Demir's voice recording brings Aras closer to his brother than ever before. However, the unheard, crackling part of the recording protects a secret from the past. This secret threatens to shake the lives they have built today. Aras races against time to uncover the truth behind the recording and find his brother. Hakan and Şebnem, meanwhile, risk everything to prevent the secret they've kept for years from being revealed. Leyla will understand the danger behind Aras's warnings. Aras and Teoman's paths unexpectedly cross again. As the past resurfaces, will a single word spoken without thinking upset all the balances?

episodes.name: Episode 16
episodes.overview: Aras, realizing that Teoman is the brother he's been searching for all these years, finds himself in a new nightmare before he can even fully enjoy the joy of their reunion. Following the events, Hakan and Şebnem take action to protect their secret and keep their family together. Aras is searching for a way to reach his brother. Meanwhile, Sıla's attempt to humiliate Deniz at school takes a completely different turn with Teoman's unexpected intervention. Şebnem tries to keep Teoman and Leyla away from Aras. Teoman's decision to settle his score with Aras will change all the plans again. When the two brothers confront each other once more, an even more difficult path lies ahead for Aras.

Gong Woo-Jin and Woo Seo-Ri get involved with each other and fall in love.

episodes.name: La Campanella
episodes.overview: 17-year-old violinist Woo Seo Ri becomes comatose after a major bus crash. Gong Woo Jin, a 17-year-old boy who likes her, witnesses the whole thing. 13 years later, at age 30, Seo Ri wakes up.

episodes.name: Where Are My Uncle and Aunt?
episodes.overview: Seo Ri wakes up from her coma and realizes she is 30; Woo Jin's sister calls him back to Seoul.

episodes.name: Elegant Ghost
episodes.overview: Seo Ri learns that her aunt and uncle have moved.

episodes.name: The Room Under the Stairs
episodes.overview: Woo Jin, Chan, and Jennifer all hear something during the night. They go the first floor and are shocked to see something coming out of a cabinet. Seo Ri stays the night at Woo Jin's place and reveals how this house became as it is now.

episodes.name: The Lands of the Unknown
episodes.overview: Hyung Tae is eager to find Seo Ri and looks everywhere. Seo Ri finds out that the hospital is searching for her, yet decides not to return. Seo Ri realizes that Woo Jin used to go to school in Germany which made her curious about Woo Jin.

episodes.name: Replacement
episodes.overview: Seo Ri fails to make the cut for the orchestra, and Chan helps to comfort her feelings. While eating tteokbokki together, Seo Ri receives good news from the violin academy that she can perform for 2 to 3 weeks as a substitute.

episodes.name: What If You Die Because of Me
episodes.overview: Seo Ri sees a man who she thinks is her uncle while heading somewhere in a car. When she tries to runs to him while the car is still moving, Woo Jin encounters flashbacks of a bad memory and grabs Seo Ri to stop her from running.

episodes.name: Apology
episodes.overview: Once Seo Ri realizes that she may have confused some other man as her uncle, Seo Ri feels regretful for talking so cruelly toward Woo Jin and chooses to apologize to him.

episodes.name: Moonlight
episodes.overview: Woo Jin sees Seo Ri going into a bar while he is having a meeting with his clients. He follows Seo Ri and shouts her name loudly to find her, but soon gets dragged out by the bouncer.

episodes.name: Flashbacks
episodes.overview: While both Woo Jin and Chan have feelings for Seo Ri, each have very different approaches toward Seo Ri.

episodes.name: I'm Scared
episodes.overview: Seo Ri joins Hee Su's team to help her organize a music festival. However, Woo Jin feels uncomfortable with the situation and confronts Hee Su about the matter.

episodes.name: Did I Do Something Wrong?
episodes.overview: Seo Ri gets drunk during the team dinner, and accidently enters Woo Jin's room which brings a very awkward situation the next morning. Woo Jin tries to avoid Seo Ri to hide his feelings, but it get harder and harder.

episodes.name: Bar 7
episodes.overview: Woo Jin sees his doctor and confesses that Seo Ri made him change to be a different person from what he used to be. Meanwhile, Chan decides to express his feelings towards Seo Ri after winning at the national competition.

episodes.name: I Want My Time Back
episodes.overview: Woo Jin gets drunk while he was trying to protect Seo Ri from Mr. Kang at the bar. Afterwards, Woo jin's behavior makes Seo Ri question the reason behind it.

episodes.name: Feeding the Fish
episodes.overview: Seo Ri is looking for a place to stay and Hyun’s cousin’s place becomes her favorite option as everything is free to use there. Chan is crushed to hear that she will move out since he has plans to admit his feelings for her.

episodes.name: Intermission
episodes.overview: Woo Jin takes Seo Ri to the ocean to cheer her up; Seo Ri shares her perspective with Woo Jin, who feels sorry for how he treated her.

episodes.name: You Like Her, Don't You?
episodes.overview: When Chan's mom visits Woo Jin's place, they decide to lie and tell her that Seo Ri is their housekeeper to avoid any drama. However, Seo Ri feels uncomfortable about lying and tries not to be seen by Chan's mom.

episodes.name: A True Adult
episodes.overview: Woo Jin convinces his father not to sell the house as he is planning to stay there more often without going abroad for months. In the meantime, Seo Ri and Hee Su get lost on an island as they cannot sail back home.

episodes.name: Art Object
episodes.overview: While Seo Ri and Woo Jin spend some time together at an empty house, Deok Su calls Woo Jin telling him that Chan has fainted. Woo Jin leaves the place immediately to see Chan which makes Seo Ri concerned.

episodes.name: Performing at the Festival
episodes.overview: Woo Jin feels uncomfortable as one of female employee tries to set a blind date up with Seo Ri and her son, so Woo Jin gets in the way to stop it.

episodes.name: You Are My Sanctuary
episodes.overview: While Woo Jin visits his therapist and tells him that he doesn't want to hide emotions from others just because he feels guilty about an incident that happened in the past.

episodes.name: The Phone Call
episodes.overview: Woo Jin accidentally overhears Byun's conversation with the reporter regarding spicing up the story about Seo Ri, so that people want to watch the pitiful girl.

episodes.name: Comfort
episodes.overview: After the motive behind the music festival is revealed, Woo Jin expresses that he doesn't want to see the woman he likes hurt. However, Seo Ri is persistent about performing and encounters a difficult time accepting the situation.

episodes.name: Don't Think, Feel

candidates.name: The Man in Room 17
candidates.overview:
The Man in Room 17 is a British television series which ran for two seasons in the mid-1960s, produced by the Northern ITV franchise, Granada Television. Key to the series' success was the involvement of writer/producer Robin Chapman.

The show was set in Room 17 of the Department of Social Research, where former wartime agent-turned-criminologist Edwin Oldenshaw solved difficult police cases through theory and discussions with his assistants.

The novelty of the series was that Oldenshaw and his colleagues never needed to leave their office in order to resolve cases, preferring to spend their time playing the Japanese board game of Go. They simply provided their prognosis and left the police to do the cleaning up. Different directors were often appointed to film the Room 17 and outside-world scenes independently, to maintain a sense of distance between the two worlds.
