candidates.name: Brigands: The Quest for Gold
candidates.overview: In the 19th century, when the southern lands of Italy are bandit territory, Filomena escapes her wealthy but sad life to lead a risky treasure hunt.

episodes.name: The Map
episodes.overview: The map to a coveted treasure reappears. Filomena rebels and a spat with her husband blows up. Sparrowhawk makes a deal with the tyrannical Piedmontese.

episodes.name: The Rifle
episodes.overview: The Monacos welcome Filomena, but Ciccilla doesn't seem to trust her. Two helpers join Sparrowhawk's venture into Mignano's feared prison.

episodes.name: The Ox
episodes.overview: Filomena seems willing to prove her loyalty to Sparrowhawk, but she ends up making a reckless move. Fumel has plans for her. Michelina seeks allies.

episodes.name: From the Earth We Will Rise
episodes.overview: Filomena wants to lead the Monacos to the gold — but when the gang gets threatened, Pietro suspects that there's a traitor among them.

episodes.name: The Bride, The Assassin, and the Lunatic
episodes.overview: The gang is divided and Sparrowhawk's secret puts him in danger. Filomena doesn't know whom to trust. Michelina's domain is challenged.

episodes.name: The Well
episodes.overview: Alliances are set, and the battle for the gold is imminent. Fumel's army feels lucky, but Filomena hatches a bold plan.

candidates.name: The Mysterious Cities of Gold
candidates.overview: The adventures of a young Spanish boy named Esteban who joins a voyage to the New World in search of the lost Cities of Gold and his father.

episodes.name: Esteban, Child of the Sun
episodes.overview: Father Rodriguez, who has looked after Esteban since he was a baby, tells him a great secret on his deathbed: somewhere his father may still be alive. So Esteban decides to begin his search in the New World. With the help of Mendoza, a mysterious man who claims to have rescued him as a baby, Esteban hides as a stowaway, aboard the Esperanza. As they are about to set sail, he meets a young Inca girl: Zia.

episodes.name: Crossing the Atlantic
episodes.overview: The two children, Esteban and Zia, find out that they both wear the same strange medallion. The Esperanza crosses the Atlantic and nears the entrance of the Straits of Magellan, where wild seas and strong winds create terrible storms. Mendoza, the navigator, prepares to spend four days and nights at the wheel.

episodes.name: Heroes Again
episodes.overview: Buffeted by a fierce wind and a wild sea, the Esperanza manages to sail through the Straits of Magellan, under Mendoza's guidance. But now, the ship faces another trial of strength: it is in the grip of a hurricane.

episodes.name: Adrift on the Endless Sea
episodes.overview: Esteban and his friends barely cross through the terrible Straits of Magellan before their ship, the Esperanza, sinks in a storm. Tossed around on a small raft and attacked by sharks, they're left in the middle of the ocean, with no provisions. But a seagull overhead guides them towards the closest shores, and they finally reach a small island.

episodes.name: The Abduction of Zia
episodes.overview: After a dangerous journey, Esteban and his friends are washed up on a mysterious island. That night, a shadowy figure comes creeping towards them. Silently, the figure steals a chart and a pistol, then snatches up Zia. Esteban gives chase. He discovers a curious house in a tree, where Zia is a prisoner. To Esteban's surprise, the mysterious shadow turns out to be a friendly boy of his own age, called Tao.

episodes.name: The Ship Solaris
episodes.overview: On a small island among the Galapagos, Esteban and Zia find a young boy living all alone: Tao. His ancestors left a magnificent ship, the Solaris, which contains their ancient secret knowledge, hidden in a temple on the island. Esteban and Zia want to use the ship to reach the mainland.

episodes.name: Secret of the Solaris
episodes.overview: Gomez' Spanish galleon overtakes and attacks the Solaris, the sun-powered ship on which the children are travelling. They manage to outrun the Spanish ship when Tao discovers a wonderful secret solar power boost, just in time. At last, they reach the new continent.

episodes.name: The New Continent
episodes.overview: After many adventures, Esteban and his friends finally set foot on the new continent. But there, they meet the soldiers of Governor Pizarro, men who think only of gold. They capture Zia and try to make her tell them the way to the Cities of Gold, but Tao and Esteban help her to escape.

episodes.name: The End of the Solaris
episodes.overview: Esteban and his companions escape from Pizarro, but their fabulous ship, the Solaris, is taken by Gaspard and Gomez. They offer to exchange the ship for Zia, and her secret. Trying to save Zia, and the friendly Inca people in the village, Tao blows up Gomez's ship, but sadly the Solaris is also destroyed.

episodes.name: Secret of the Temple
episodes.overview: Esteban and his friends are on their way to Zia's village, when they are surrounded by Spanish soldiers. The children manage to escape, and take refuge in an underground temple, where they meet the old priest, Pasha. To help them escape, the priest melts the pillar of ice that supports the temple roof, and it crashes down on top of him. The others just manage to get away.

episodes.name: Messengers of the Region
episodes.overview: Gomez captures the children and forces Zia to reveal the secret of the Golden Quipu. It is an Inca message which reveals that the Cities of Gold lie beyond the High Mountain Peak. In the night, Esteban and the children escape. They find a secret underground passage and set off for the High Peak.

episodes.name: Secret of the Medallions
episodes.overview: The Spanish army follow Esteban and his friends to the Fort of the Black Eagle. Under cover of darkness, the Spaniards attack the fort, but Tao devises a rocket flare that repels the attackers, saving the fort. The three children leave the fort and at last reach the City of the High Peak, whose chief, Kraka, tells them that the medallions Esteban and Zia wear can open the doors of Sela, one of the Cities of Gold.

episodes.name: Mystery of the Parents
episodes.overview: When Esteban arrives at the place called the High Peak, he meets an old man, Mayuka, who seems to know something about his parents.

episodes.name: Esteban's Medallions
episodes.overview: Mendoza steals the Spanish army's cannon in order to win the trust of the Indians, but his plan fails. As the three Spaniards are about to be executed, Esteban comes to save them. But he demands that Mendoza give him back the sun section of his gold medallion.

episodes.name: The Subterranean Secret
episodes.overview: Gomez and his soldiers attack the Fort of the Black Eagle to try to recapture the cannon Mendoza had stolen. Mendoza uses the cannon to fight back, but cannot stop the Spanish army who storm the fort and drive the Incas out. Esteban, Tao and Zia run away towards the High Peak, following secret underground passages constructed by the Incas.

episodes.name: The Urubus
episodes.overview: Searching for the Cities of Gold, Esteban and his friends cross a high plateau up in the Andes. Near Lake Titicaca, they are attacked by the Urubus, a tribe of giants. Tao invents a submarine, and they capture Karuga, chief of the tribe, and hold him prisoner. Karuga tells them that there's a City of Gold on a mountain, guarded by the earth goddess, Pachamama.

episodes.name: The Great Condor
episodes.overview: The setting sunlight leads Esteban and his friends to the statue of the earth goddess, Pachamama. The legend goes that when Pachamama takes the sun in her arms, the Gates to the Cities of Gold will open. Estaban and Zia place their medallions in the statue and the mountain opens up to reveal the first City of Gold. Inside they discover a great bird, made of solid gold.

episodes.name: Maiden Flight of the Condor
episodes.overview: Inside the first City of Gold, Esteban finds a great Golden Condor. When the volcano on which the Cities are built begins to erupt, the Cities are destroyed. Sheltering inside the body of the Condor, they try to make its mechanism work, using the Medallion of the Sun. Suddenly, the giant bird spreads its wings and takes flight.

episodes.name: The Nasca Plateau
episodes.overview: The great Golden Condor, carrying Esteban and his friends away from Pachamama and the erupting volcano, lands in the desert at Nazca. But when Pizarro and his soldiers arrive, Esteban makes sure everyone escapes.

episodes.name: The Spaniards' Cannon
episodes.overview: The Golden Condor carries Esteban and his companions to the High Peak, where they encounter the Spanish forces, armed with their cannon. With the help of the Golden Condor, they stop Gomez and Gaspard. And when they had saved their friends, they leave the High Peak, in search of the land of the Mayas.

episodes.name: The Amazons
episodes.overview: The group head for the land of the Mayas, on board the Golden Condor, when they are forced to land in the jungle. They are captured by Amazon warriors and taken to their temple, to be sacrificed to the Rain God. But Esteban uses his special powers, and the sun comes out. The Queen is so impressed by his power to command the sun, that she orders their release.

episodes.name: The Mirror of the Moon
episodes.overview: Esteban and his friends on board the Golden Condor have to make a forced landing in the jungle, where they're captured by Amazon warriors who want to sacrifice them to their Rain God. After some difficulties, they manage to escape from this dangerous situation. And in the end, the Queen of the Amazons allows them to leave for the land of the Mayas.

episodes.name: The Jade Mask
episodes.overview: In the jungle, Esteban and his friends discover some ruins, deserted temples and pyramids. In one of the temples, Pedro and Sancho try to remove a jade mask from the wall when the mask begins to glow. Suddenly the stone beams shoot out of the walls, ceiling and floor and trip them up.

episodes.name: The Manuscript
episodes.overview: After solving the secret of the green jade mask, Esteban and his friends find a manuscript which seems to hold the key to the whereabouts of the Cities of Gold. But almost immediately, they are captured by Doctor Fernando Laguerra and his friend, Marinche, who are also searching for the Cities of Gold. However, Kokapetl manages to rescue them all.

episodes.name: The Lake of Gold
episodes.overview: Esteban and his friends are captured by Indians who wanted to sacrifice them to purify their sacred lake of gold. Marinche and Doctor Laguerra try to poison the lake so they could get at all the treasure on the bottom. Mendoza foils their plan by breaking through the dam, flooding the village and allowing the children to escape.

episodes.name: The Swamps
episodes.overview: The Serpent God of the Mayas was said to have crossed the mountains to build a new city in the east, among the swamps of the Rain God. Setting out to find this second city, Esteban and his friends are tricked by Marinche, and find themselves fighting the alligators in the marshes. After a savage battle, they escape to the other side of the swamp.

episodes.name: The Doors of Night
episodes.overview: Esteban and his friends find the second City of Gold, but they are captured by Marinche and the Doctor. The Doctor finds a new manuscript, but is caught in a trap set into the floor of the temple. The children get the manuscript which tells of a third city, to be found near a forest of statues.

episodes.name: The Forest of Statues
episodes.overview: After much travelling and many adventures, Esteban and his friends finally discover the third temple built deep inside an enormous cave. A golden statue is holding a third manuscript which mentions a mountain known as "The Burning Shield".

episodes.name: The Burning Shield
episodes.overview: Having found the Burning Shield, Esteban and his friends fall into the hands of the mysterious Olmecs, who possess very advanced technology. They escape from them, but are captured again. So what will happen to them now?

episodes.name: The Escape
episodes.overview: Using their advanced technology, the Olmecs are able to collect energy from the heat of the sun, and from deep inside the Earth. They capture Esteban, Tao and Zia, intent on transplanting their cells to regenerate their elders, so they can become young again. With Mendoza's help, the children manage to escape.

episodes.name: The Village of the New Sun
episodes.overview: Esteban and his friends are guests at the Village of the New Sun. But the Olmecs have found the Golden Condor, and prepare to attack the village, with the help of the Doctor and Marinche, who mean to steal the great golden bird for themselves. Meanwhile, Myena discovers that Papacamayo, the old chief, is really Zia's father.

episodes.name: Attack of the Olmecs
episodes.overview: With the help of Gomez and Gaspard, Esteban and his friends succeed in getting the Golden Condor to fly. But the Olmecs find the Indian Village of the New Sun, and mount a fierce attack. With the help of the Golden Condor, they are defeated. But Zia's father, Papacamayo, has been seriously wounded.

episodes.name: The Reunion
episodes.overview: In the Indian Village of the New Sun, Zia at last finds her father, Papacamayo. But her happiness is short-lived, when he dies from his wounds, after defending the village against an attack by the Olmecs. All the Mayan tribes unite to fight against the Olmecs.

episodes.name: Revolt of the Mayas
episodes.overview: The Mayan people arm themselves and attack the Olmecs, who have been tyrannising them for years. A fierce battle takes place near the entrance to the Olmec base. From the Golden Condor, Esteban and the other children bombard the Olmecs with stones, turning the tide of the battle in favour of the Mayas.

episodes.name: The Olmec Machine
episodes.overview: Esteban and his friends manage to find their way into the Olmec base. But Kalmec discovers them, and takes Zia prisoner. Suddenly, a gigantic war machine rushes up from deep inside the Olmec underground temple.

episodes.name: Aerial Pursuit
episodes.overview: Esteban flies the Golden Condor against the terrible Olmec war machine, to try to rescue Zia. Tao and Esteban manage to leap onto the machine in mid-air, and Zia is saved. But Tao is left behind, a prisoner.

episodes.name: The City of Gold
episodes.overview: With Tao as a hostage, the Olmecs force Esteban and Zia to use their medallions to open the doors to the City of Gold.

episodes.name: The Great Legacy
episodes.overview: After wounding the High Priest of the Cities of Gold, Kalmec steals the Great Treasure, a concentrated source of the sun's power also called the Sun Power Unit. However, the security systems of the City are activated and destroy the Olmecs' flying machine. Kalmec and Menator make their way back to their base, taking the Great Treasure with them.

episodes.name: End of the City of Gold
episodes.overview: The Olmecs place the Sun Power Unit at the bottom of their sunlight collecting crystal and activate it. However, the unit does not behave as expected and the Sun Power Unit begins to overheat. The High Priest of the Cities of Gold, who turns out to be Esteban's father, tries to shut it down using Tao's jar which is actually a control unit. But he could be too late.

episodes.overview: Freelance pilot Jake Cutter and his mechanic Corky become involved with Nazis and American Sarah Stickney White while searching the south Pacific for a mythical gold monkey.

episodes.overview: Jake, posing as a defecting U.S. scientist, and Sarah search for an experimental German bomb and a famed black pearl.

episodes.overview: A former Flying Tiger asks Jake's help in finding the fabled lost treasure of King Solomon.

episodes.name: Escape From Death Island
episodes.overview: Jake and Corky are imprisoned on an island penal colony when they try to free the son of an Englishman.

episodes.name: Trunk From the Past
episodes.overview: Sarah receives a mysterious trunk from her late father and it leads her to a lost civilization.

episodes.name: Once a Tiger...
episodes.overview: Jake leads the search for a downed plane flown by a former Flying Tiger transporting a prototype gunsight of interest to the Japanese.

episodes.name: Honor Thy Brother
episodes.overview: Jake is followed by the brother of a Japanese pilot he shot down while he was still a Flying Tiger in China, and Corky struggles to avoid a prearranged marriage.

episodes.name: The Lady and the Tiger
episodes.overview: Jake is shot down and rescued by an Amish widow and her son, who hide him from the Japanese occupying their island.

episodes.name: The Late Sarah White
episodes.overview: Jake and Corky fly to the Philippines to explore the reports of Sarah's death while on a mission involving MacArthur.

episodes.name: Mourning Becomes Matuka

candidates.overview: In the spring when the cherry blossom petals fall, Yū Narukami moves to Yaso Inaba to live with his uncle and cousin due to his family's circumstances. He transfers to Yasogami High School, where his event-filled school life begins. However, when serial murders begin occurring in the peaceful town, Yū is awakened to the power of his heart turned to physical form: A Persona. Within these new mysteries is Marie, a resident of the alternate world, the Velvet Room, who has no memories of her past. Together with his friends, Yū must solve all the riddles set in front of him and save Yaso Inaba from further violence.

episodes.name: The Golden Days
episodes.overview: A teenager named Yu Narukami transfers to Yasogami High School. He hears from his new friends about something called the "Midnight Channel." Will he attempt to watch a turned-off TV on a rainy night to find out what it is all about?

episodes.name: The Perfect Plan
episodes.overview: Yosuke tells Yu that they should get motorcycles to pick up girls. They head to Okina City on their new bikes on the day that Yu is also supposed to meet Marie, Chie, and Yukiko for clothes shopping. How will he manage to keep everyone happy?

episodes.name: I Have Amnesia, Is It So Bad?
episodes.overview: Yu and his friends head down to the beach to enjoy the last days of summer. Everyone seems very keen on knowing more about Marie, even though they are unaware that she has lost her memories.

episodes.overview: A teenager named Yu Narukami transfers to Yasogami High School. He hears from his new friends about something called the "Midnight Channel." Will he attempt to watch a turned-off TV on a rainy night to find out what it is all about?

episodes.overview: Yosuke asks Rise to get up on stage and perform to help him and his father. Rise accepts on one condition… That they will all take the stage as a band! Will they succeed in playing music together as a group?

episodes.name: See? I Told You, Yu.
episodes.overview: There is a new detective in town. He starts working with Dojima. Marie thinks that he gives off a bad vibe and warns Yu to stay away from him. However, Yu wants to get to know him better. Is Marie right about her hunch?

episodes.name: It's Cliché, So What?
episodes.overview: Ryotaro and Nanako are in the Inaba Municipal Hospital. Yu gets worried when Dojima tells him that Adachi is at the hospital with them. Yu and the gang go after Adachi. Will Yu be able to convince Adachi to turn himself in?

episodes.name: Not So Holy Christmas Eve
episodes.overview: Yu asks his friends if they are free on Christmas Eve. The girls are under the impression that Yu is asking for a date. How will things prevail?

episodes.name: A Missing Piece
episodes.overview: Yu is leaving soon and everyone decides they need to make sure their time together is memorable. But as they all go to a ski resort they begin to realise memories of a forgotten past.

episodes.name: Not a Friend Anymore
episodes.overview: Yu and his friends try to bring Marie back, but the truth behind her memories is preventing them from doing so.

episodes.name: Let it OUT! Let it GO!
episodes.overview: Yu and his friends make their last stand to save Marie and bring her back.

episodes.name: Welcome Home
episodes.overview: Will Yu and his friends finally find out who Marie really is?

candidates.name: Transformers: EarthSpark

episodes.name: Secret Legacy (1) / Secret Legacy (2)
episodes.overview: Robby has trouble adjusting after their family's big move to the rural town of Witwicky, until he and his sister, Mo, discover the first-ever Earthborn Transformers.

episodes.name: Moo-ving In
episodes.overview: As the Malto family get used to its new members, Bumblebee quickly learns that his mission to train the Terrans won't be as easy as he thought.

episodes.name: House Rules
episodes.overview: Thrash is impatient with the family rules and convinces Mo to push their boundaries. But when a Decepticon needs their help, Mo and Thrash find themselves playing by a far more dangerous set of rules.

episodes.name: Classified
episodes.overview: G.H.O.S.T. Special Agent Schloder pursues Twitch after mistaking her for a Deception. Meanwhile, Dot is put through G.H.O.S.T. orientation, where she learns that her employer's intentions may not be what they seem.

episodes.name: Traditions
episodes.overview: Robby backs out of Alex's traditional Wakwak hunt, so Alex shares his family history with Bumblebee, while Twitch, eager to gain her own traditions, encounters "Dad2" - Wheeljack.

episodes.name: Family and Friends
episodes.overview: The Terrans' erratic behavior may be affecting Mo and Robby's anxiety about their first day at their new school. Or it could be something far worse...

episodes.name: Decoy
episodes.overview: While out on a mission to capture three Mini-Cassette bots, Megatron and Optimus Prime have a disagreement about G.H.O.S.T.'s treatment of Decepticons.

episodes.name: Age of Evolution (1) / Age of Evolution (2)
episodes.overview: Twitch and Thrash wonder if they're the only Terrans on Earth. Their family, Optimus Prime, and Bumblebee help seek answers and find new allies! Meanwhile, Mandroid captures Dot and Megatron. Can the larger group become a team and save their friends?

episodes.name: Hashtag: Oops
episodes.overview: Twitch helps Hashtag choose her alt-mode, and it takes them both for a wild and G.H.O.S.T.-ly ride that Bumblebee must help them escape.

episodes.name: Outtakes
episodes.overview: Jawbreaker wonders how to choose the right alt-mode. He interviews other bots on camera to hear their perspectives. But when Hashtag gets involved, Jawbreaker's project loses focus.

episodes.name: Missed Connection
episodes.overview: When Nightshade's feeling isolated from the rest of the Malto family, they find a new connection in the most unlikely of places.

episodes.name: Security Protocols
episodes.overview: Bumblebee's past as an elite racecar driver is exposed and Special Agent Schloder is hot on his trail.

episodes.name: Bear Necessities
episodes.overview: Mother's Day goes wrong and the Maltos discover a toxic threat to Mother Earth.

episodes.name: Warzone
episodes.overview: Robby and Mo join the Terrans on a visit to the Spacebridge Memorial Park, but the memory of the siege opens old wounds...and more...for Megatron.

episodes.name: Home (1) / Home (2)
episodes.overview: The kids and Terrans sneak out for a night of fun in Philadelphia, but their dream of visiting the big city transforms into a nightmare.

episodes.name: A Stygi Situation
episodes.overview: Jawbreaker finally chooses an alt-mode, but instead of changing into it, the alt-mode changes him.

episodes.name: Disarmed
episodes.overview: Robby, Mo, and the Terrans attempt to unlock new Cybersleeve powers, with disastrous results.

episodes.name: What Dwells Within
episodes.overview: The Malto kids are lost in an underground maze of tunnels with a mysterious monster stalking them. To survive, they must team up with Starscream! But can they trust him?

episodes.name: Prime Time
episodes.overview: Feeling helpless as Robby's condition worsens, Mo wishes she had never touched the Emberstone. Quintus Prime shows the young hero that because of her, the world is a better place.

episodes.name: Stowed Away, Stowaways
episodes.overview: Optimus Prime suspects G.H.O.S.T. is hiding something and sends Bumblebee on a secret recon mission deep inside G.H.O.S.T. HQ. The young Maltos sneak in and help their mentor.

episodes.name: The Battle of Witwicky
episodes.overview: The truth about the Terrans is revealed as the Malto family makes a last stand against Croft and her sinister forces within G.H.O.S.T.

episodes.name: Last Hope
episodes.overview: The Malto family must overcome insurmountable odds to stop Mandroid once and for all and save Cybertronian kind.

1.overview: A new generation of Transformers is born, the first to do so on Earth, and find themselves adopted by a human family. As they adapt to their new home, they attempt to find their place in the world amidst the war between the Autobots and Decepticons.

candidates.name: False Identity
candidates.overview: Isabel and Diego, two complete strangers, must assume the identity of a married couple in order to flee the state of Sonora.

episodes.name: Isabel and Diego's Challenge
episodes.overview: The mayor hatches a plan to hide his brother from Gavino's cartel and Isabel from her abusive husband. Gavino puts a price on Diego's head.

episodes.name: Isabel and Diego Flee to the United States
episodes.overview: Isabel, Diego, and little Ricardo cross into the United States. They are now Camila, Emiliano, and Max Guevara. Eliseo declares war on Gavino.

episodes.name: Circe Betrays Her Father
episodes.overview: Eliseo learns that Augusto, the Sonora boss, financed his campaign. To prove it, he gives Circe the coordinates for the next shipment of cocaine.

episodes.name: Gavino Threatens Circe
episodes.overview: After losing the goods to the feds, Gavino discovers who sold him out. Isabel, Ricardo, and Diego arrive in Mexico City. Isabel's daughter disappears.

episodes.name: Circe and Joselito Make Love
episodes.overview: Thrown out of her house, Circe moves in with Joselito, who says he's the reason she's still alive. Augusto fakes a kidnapping. Isabel can't find work.

episodes.name: Isabel Will Do Anything for Her Daughter
episodes.overview: Amanda is in danger every second she's with her father. Isabel begins working at a cabaret to be able to pay a good lawyer, and Diego wants to help.

episodes.name: Circe Requests Eliseo's Head
episodes.overview: Gavino's daughter seeks revenge on Diego, so she seduces Joselito and promises to please him in return for a favor. Piochas and Deivid find Isabel.

episodes.name: Diego is Exposed on Television
episodes.overview: Emiliano Guevara is interviewed after saving a man's life. Eliseo is annoyed with his brother and resigns from his job to run for governor.

episodes.name: Isabel Has a Secret
episodes.overview: Isabel lies to Diego about her job again and he plans to expose her. Joselito's thug corners Eliseo. Camila confronts Ramona.

episodes.name: Isabel and Diego Kiss
episodes.overview: Diego is jealous when Isabel dances for others and demands she quit. Eliseo knows Joselito was with his attacker. Marlene sees Lourdes being taken.

episodes.name: Eliseo Suspects Augusto
episodes.overview: Zoraida gives Eliseo the gun her stepfather used to kill the prosecutor in return for help saving Amanda. Joselito won't give in to Circe's blackmail.

episodes.name: Isabel and Diego Make Love
episodes.overview: Isabel tells Diego she's in love with him; they spend the night together. Eliseo faces Augusto. Gavino learns Diego is back; he orders a manhunt.

episodes.name: Amanda's Rescue
episodes.overview: Amanda's rescue gets tricky. Corona appears to stop Isabel from taking her daughter. Diego confronts him; the three escape. Gavino gets bad news.

episodes.name: Circe Leaves Everything for Diego
episodes.overview: Circe leaves Joselito at the altar and threatens Eliseo so he will take her to Diego. Isabel won't leave Diego. Corona files a kidnapping report.

episodes.name: Circe Kills Diego's Brother
episodes.overview: Circe frames Gavino. The feds arrest the Boss. Diego appears at his brother's house and thinks he's kidnapped.

episodes.name: Diego Is at a Loss for His Brother
episodes.overview: Diego confirms who killed Eliseo and swears revenge. Isabel looks for Diego at the funeral. Joselito orders Circe's murder.

episodes.name: An Attack Is Made on Eliseo's Wake
episodes.overview: Gavino's men come to the funeral to kill Circe and Diego. Isabel is in love. Joselito finds Circe and ties her up. Gavino is beaten in prison.

episodes.name: Isabel and Diego Settle Down
episodes.overview: Diego tells Isabel he loves her and wants to start a family. Corona finds out who killed his mother. Joselito orders Deivid's mother killed.

episodes.name: Fernanda is Put in the Street
episodes.overview: Fernanda is suicidal because of what has happened to her. Joselito wants to make Circe ask for forgiveness. Gavino is eager to get out of prison.

episodes.name: Circe arrives at Babel
episodes.overview: After the cartel puts a price on their heads, Circe and Felipa go to Mexico City. Corona drops the charges. Diego wants to go to Babel with Isabel.

episodes.name: Joselito Orders a Kidnapping
episodes.overview: The cartel doesn't have a bead on Circe or Diego and thinks they left together. Joselito orders Fernanda to be kidnapped. Jim makes Isabel an offer.

episodes.name: Gavino on the Brink of Death
episodes.overview: Gavino is badly hurt in a prison attack. Joselito wants him dead so he can lead the cartel. Fernanda arrives at Diego's house. Jim seeks investors.

episodes.name: Circe Creates Her Own Cartel
episodes.overview: With Augusto's money and Brandon's aid, Circe will wipe out the Gaonas to form the world's strongest cartel. Isabel learns who Marlene's boyfriend is.

episodes.name: Circe's Great Moment
episodes.overview: Circe seizes the Gaonas' business. Corona finds his son. Piochas plans to rescue Gavino. Isabel learns what Augusto is doing.

episodes.name: Episode 25
episodes.overview: Isabel tells Diego that Porfirio is closing in. Diego will do anything to protect his family. The Colombians make other deals, but Joselito finds out.

episodes.name: Diego Rejects Circe
episodes.overview: Circe learns Diego is with another woman and swears to have no mercy. Corona comes to Isabel's house. Piochas looks to get Gavino out of the hospital.

episodes.name: Circe Meets Camila
episodes.overview: The new dancer at Babel catches Circe's eye; she asks to meet her, not knowing she's with Diego. Corona reveals Diego and Fernanda's location.

episodes.name: Joselito Lets Diego Live
episodes.overview: Diego decides to go because the cartel may return for him. Joselito gets Isabel's photo. Circe successfully moves drugs. Gavino knows he was betrayed.

episodes.name: Joselito Recognizes Isabel
episodes.overview: Joselito confirms Camila is with Diego and has her take him to the table. Corona and Diego fight over Isabel. Circe agrees to meet the Gaonas.

episodes.name: Camila Flirts With Joselito
episodes.overview: Joselito continues toying with Camila. She thinks it's under control and he doesn't recognize her. Augusto realizes who killed Eliseo.

episodes.name: Circe and Joselito Face to Face
episodes.overview: Joselito meets Hot Mama and learns that she is Circe. They threaten each other's lives over the drug trade. The dancers are at risk.

episodes.name: Danger finds Isabel in Babel
episodes.overview: Joselito goes crazy when he finds out that the waitresses escaped. Diego learns the truth about Babel. The warden orders Gavino back to his cell.

episodes.name: Diego Distances Himself From Isabel
episodes.overview: Isabel asks for Diego's forgiveness. Upset, he asks for space to decide if they should stay together. Circe visits Gavino in prison; he attacks her.

episodes.name: Circe Wants to Recruit Diego
episodes.overview: Hot Mama has one day to move the goods and wants Diego as a guide. Joselito can give her the location. Diego contacts the real Emiliano's aunt.

episodes.name: Circe Arrives at Diego's House
episodes.overview: With the information Joselito gives her, Circe figures out who robbed her man. Joselito visits Gavino in prison. Corona's condition worsens.

episodes.name: Isabel and Diego Reconcile
episodes.overview: After Circe's visit, Diego tells Isabel the truth about his past. They promise to start over. Marlene begins to suspect Augusto.

episodes.name: Circe Receives a Threat
episodes.overview: The Colombians want to see their goods arrive. If Circe can't hold up her end, they'll get back at her and Diego. The Gaonas have Brandon and Augusto.

episodes.name: The Plot Set Against Joselito
episodes.overview: Joselito intercepts the truckload of drugs. Fernanda finds out who her husband's lover is. Isabel wants to help her children's father.

episodes.name: Joselito Sends a Message
episodes.overview: Joselito seeks revenge on Diego. Hot Mama seduces Diego. Corona goes to the hospital. Joselito interrogates Augusto and orders Felipa kidnapped.

episodes.name: Circe Receives a Big Hit
episodes.overview: The Gaonas have Felipa. Circe and the girls arrive at Babel to rescue her. Diego accepts the Colombians' offer. Fernanda confronts Augusto.

episodes.name: Isabel Quits the Farce
episodes.overview: To protect her kids, Isabel decides to leave her fake marriage. Circe has half the country after Joselito: she offers a million dollars for his head.

episodes.name: Luck Is on Circe's Side
episodes.overview: Circe learns that Diego is a free man and seeks to win back the love of her life. Gavino starts doing business in jail. Deivid advises Chucho.

episodes.name: Isabel's Children Are Taken
episodes.overview: Joselito can't stand Diego working with Circe and sends his men out to get him. Corona wants to get back his family and his wife's love.

episodes.name: The Plan to Kill Joselito
episodes.overview: Piochas and Mateo prepare an ambush to get rid of Joselito and obtain the reward. Isabel doesn't want to see Diego again. Circe casts a love spell.

episodes.name: Corona, Closer to Death
episodes.overview: Corona's health deteriorates. Isabel is ready to do anything to save her children's father. Diego and Circe take territory from Joselito.

episodes.name: Joselito Goes After Circe
episodes.overview: The Gaonas attack Hot Mama's warehouse, and Joselito does everything he can to get her. Circe tries to escape but is shot. Fernanda divorces Augusto.

episodes.name: The Passion of Diego
episodes.overview: Diego rescues Circe and takes her to his house to heal her wounds. Hot Mama reminds him that he's hers. Isabel decides to give herself a chance.

episodes.name: Isabel With the Broken Heart
episodes.overview: After the real Emiliano's aunt visits, Isabel looks for Diego. When she finds him, she gets the surprise of her life. Circe frames Augusto.

episodes.name: Circe Makes a Move
episodes.overview: Hot Mama wants to multitask: if Joselito and Augusto will come to her, she can kill them both. Marlene can't believe her fiance is a killer.

episodes.name: Circe's Sweet Revenge
episodes.overview: Circe enjoys seeing Joselito and Augusto tied up and decides to take what's owed her. Mateo wants to start a new business. Marlene confronts Diego.

episodes.name: Paloma Confronts Camila
episodes.overview: Isabel's need is growing. She is looking for work and tells Paloma one of her biggest secrets. Diego feels betrayed by his loved ones.

episodes.name: Circe and Diego Are in for a Surprise
episodes.overview: Desperate to see his stepfather, Diego gets Circe to take him to where Joselito and Augusto are; something unexpected happens. Gavino has a plan.

episodes.name: Joselito's Other Face
episodes.overview: Joselito has to change plans and find help to regain power. Circe, Diego, and the Colombians know where he is and corner him.

episodes.name: Diego Sleeps With the Enemy
episodes.overview: Diego goes to the hospital to get rid of Augusto. Circe wants to kill the man she loves before he learns the truth. Marlene makes a wedding decision.

episodes.name: Episode 55
episodes.overview: Things get even worse for Isabel; Margot Guevara threatens to put her in prison. Circe has a hard time seeing Diego at his brother's grave.

episodes.name: Diego's New Plan
episodes.overview: Circe must decide if she wants to do the same as Diego. He wants to make a change in his life. Isabel looks for Diego. Margot wants more evidence.

episodes.name: Diego Ready to Face the Music
episodes.overview: Isabel can't leave the city. Diego wants to talk to Margot to tell her the truth. Augusto agrees to testify on Gavino's behalf.

episodes.name: A Ticking Time Bomb for Isabel and Diego
episodes.overview: Margot is about to find proof of Isabel and Diego's charade. Circe makes them look for Emiliano's aunt. Isabel gets an opportunity to flee.

episodes.name: Circe Stains Her Hands With Blood for Diego
episodes.overview: To separate Diego and Isabel, Circe finds Emiliano's aunt to threaten her, but she loses control. Marlene confronts Augusto; Mateo blackmails Isabel.

episodes.name: Circe Exposes Herself
episodes.overview: Diego knows that Circe is involved with the Guevaras' aunt's death. She learns Margot thwarted her plans to leave with him. Isabel wants the truth.

episodes.name: Augusto Publicly Accuses Joselito
episodes.overview: Augusto attests to Gavino's innocence and says Joselito is the real cartel boss. Isabel feels like she's to blame. Circe and Diego plan to leave.

episodes.name: Circe and Diego Must Pay a High Price
episodes.overview: Hot Mama's dream of leaving with Diego is interrupted when they get an ultimatum they must comply with. Diana and Gaby get into trouble.

episodes.name: Circe's World Collapses
episodes.overview: Hot Mama visits her father in prison. She confronts him and the Boss fires back, telling her Felipa's deepest secret. Gaby may be deported.

episodes.name: Episode 64
episodes.overview: Circe is furious with Felipa and wants to kill her. Diego shares his plan with Deivid. Corona and Mateo get out of surgery. Augusto attacks Marlene.

episodes.name: Episode 65
episodes.overview: Hot Mama plans to get out of the business, but Gavino is ready to bring her down. She doesn't know what she's up against. Diego plans his last move.

episodes.name: All in Gavino Gaona's Favor
episodes.overview: At Gavino's trial, Augusto testifies on his behalf; Eliseo's memory becomes tainted. Isabel learns that Diego and Circe are leaving the country.

episodes.name: Episode 67
episodes.overview: The Boss makes his move and achieves his goals. He begins to take revenge by killing all his enemies and capturing Circe. Diego looks for Gavino.

episodes.name: Episode 68
episodes.overview: Circe begins to feel her father's wrath. The Boss does his best to leave her without allies or a way out; he talks to Ramona to learn her escape plan.

episodes.name: Episode 69
episodes.overview: The Boss and Diego are even. Each one has in his power someone important to the other and is sure that the other will do everything to find her.

episodes.name: Diego Is Speechless
episodes.overview: After getting some of his enemies together, Gavino proposes a truce to Diego. Circe tries to save her business. Joselito decides to return to Mexico.

episodes.name: Circe's Right-Hand Man
episodes.overview: Desperate, Hot Mama thinks Diego can save her, not knowing that he's waiting for the moment to attack. Marlene talks about her feelings for Jim.

episodes.name: Circe and Diego Look Each Other in the Eye
episodes.overview: Gavino sows discord between Circe and Diego. Augusto tries to take advantage of Marlene's sister. Gaby wants to go to the U.S., far from Deivid.

episodes.name: Diego's Proposal
episodes.overview: After buttering up Circe, Diego makes an offer. She says they will get the goods back soon. The Colombians are uneasy about Joselito's return.

episodes.name: Episode 74
episodes.overview: Thinking she knows what Diego is up to, Circe calls him, but he decides not to talk to her. Porfirio learns that the feds are looking for his father.

episodes.name: Episode 75
episodes.overview: Isabel goes to Alamos with Diego, but is followed by security cameras there. Circe confronts her father.

episodes.name: Episode 76
episodes.overview: Gavino swears Circe is out of the business; he visits the Colombians to get more power, but all is not as it seems. Isabel and Diego work as a team.

episodes.name: Episode 77
episodes.overview: Although Diego wants to keep Isabel out of his plans, she won't leave his side. Gavino wants Circe out of the drug trade. Joselito is about to attack.

episodes.name: Episode 78
episodes.overview: Joselito plans to take out Gavino at Babel. When he's about to kill the Boss, something happens to change his plans. Porfirio and Paloma are together.

episodes.name: Diego in Circe's Claws
episodes.overview: Circe still thinks she has control of Diego, but she misses something. The feds get Joselito; Gavino wants his head. Mateo wants to show his loyalty.

episodes.name: Episode 80
episodes.overview: As the feds are moving Joselito, they are caught in an ambush. Mateo shows he is loyal to Gavino. Diego is close to his goal, but Circe is suspicious.

episodes.name: Episode 81
episodes.overview: Gavino wants to settle scores with Joselito. Nuria endures a traumatic episode. Circe begins to investigate Diego. Jim sets fire to Babel.

episodes.name: Circe Receives a Grim Present
episodes.overview: Gavino finds Circe and leaves her a chilling message. Diego asks for immunity for Isabel and himself. Porfirio threatens to take Isabel's children.

episodes.name: Diego Exposed
episodes.overview: Diego plans to capture Circe, who faces her worst nightmare. Agent Williams finds Isabel's house. Gavino wants to ally with Alex Mendez.

episodes.name: Circe's Sinister Plan
episodes.overview: Diego wants to avenge his brother's death, but Hot Mama has a different plan. Williams has the proof he needs to arrest Isabel and Diego.

episodes.name: Diego Declares War on Circe
episodes.overview: After an attempt at capture fails, Diego and Circe come clean. Gavino's ruse is exposed. Isabel agrees to be separated from her children.

episodes.name: Diego's Difficult Decision
episodes.overview: There's only one way for Diego to protect Isabel and the children. Fernanda's restaurant is attacked. Circe has a new ally. Amanda disappears.

episodes.name: Diego in the Wolf's Mouth
episodes.overview: After Gavino's attack, Diego decides to take justice into his own hands. Mateo goes behind Gavino's back. Isabel threatens her father-in-law.

episodes.name: Episode 88
episodes.overview: Isabel's worst nightmare becomes reality and there's no way out. Marlene finds Jim. Circe accepts Mateo's offer. Nuria confesses to her addiction.

episodes.name: Circe Corners Gavino
episodes.overview: The leader of the Gaonas falls into Mateo's trap. Circe seeks revenge. Isabel and Diego receive an offer. Salas turns himself in to the authorities.

episodes.name: Episode 90
episodes.overview: The war between father and daughter ends. Isabel is on the verge of death; Diego and Porfirio work together to save her. Salas says he's to blame.

episodes.name: Episode 91
episodes.overview: Isabel and Diego are ready to be a family, but an enemy is lurking. Circe tries to escape. Paloma loses a loved one. Fernanda says goodbye to Salas.

1.name: Season 1
1.overview: Strangers Diego and Isabel flee their home in Mexico and pretend to be a married couple to escape his drug-dealing enemies and her abusive husband.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: Diego and Isabel are in a witness protection program, but he breaks the rules to get in touch with his mother Fernanda. Ignacio Salas remains free.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: Circe faces murder, drug trafficking and money laundering charges. Rogelio receives a cry for help. The Sonora prosecutor intervenes, with conditions.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: Amanda goes to meet her grandfather. Isabel's love for her daughter is so great that it pushes her to make a drastic decision to get her family back.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: The die is cast. Now that hatred is Circe's driving force, heads will roll. Mami Chula and El Buitre join forces for revenge.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: Badly wounded, Diego takes refuge in a church to flee Mateo's men, who are armed to the teeth. Victoria and Father Rafael must make a decision.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: Diego and Isabel are so close, yet so far. Victoria and Father Rafael begin the escape plan, but El Pollo is suspicious. Fernanda confronts Mateo.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: Amanda tells her grandfather how she and her brother suffered at the hands of Circe and Alex. Ramona must pick a side: her lover's or her niece's?

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: Circe and El Buitre are together and everyone is talking. Mateo goes to look for them. A tense situation may cost the Arismendi family dearly.

episodes.name: Episode 9
episodes.overview: Diego, Deivid and Chucho follow Circe's trail to the cemetery. Mami Chula thinks she sees Joselito among the tombstones. Diana goes to the police.

episodes.name: Episode 10
episodes.overview: Rosa just wants to flee, but Circe insists on going after Diego to finish him. Diana ends up in the hospital. Chucho suffers a painful interrogation.

episodes.name: Episode 11
episodes.overview: Isabel takes a risk, says goodbye to Ricas, and meets The Man. She puts her plan into action once at the hotel... not thinking of the consequences.

episodes.name: Episode 12
episodes.overview: Mateo finds Circe's hideout and goes after her. El Buitre and his father become unwilling accomplices. Mami Chula hears when Claudio challenges Mateo.

episodes.name: Episode 13
episodes.overview: Isabel will try to rescue her daughter and Fernanda, but she'll need more than luck and accomplices to evade security at the hacienda.

episodes.name: Episode 14
episodes.overview: Isabel is forced to tell Mateo where his grandson is. Meanwhile, Ramona advises Mateo to let others do the dirty work. Amanda misses her family.

episodes.name: Episode 15
episodes.overview: Circe knows how to attract men...and El Buitre is no exception. Claudio shows what he's made of, though he doesn't know he's missing something.

episodes.name: Episode 16
episodes.overview: Circe receives key information to kill Diego. Mami Chula uses the same frequency as Mateo's truck. Lupe and Alberto play an important role.

episodes.name: Episode 17
episodes.overview: In the desert, Mateo's victims are dehydrated and running out of air. A hole in the truck becomes a coveted prize. Salas gives Diego some information.

episodes.name: Episode 18
episodes.overview: Diego and Victoria search for Isabel, who's nowhere to be found. Only one place remains to look: the morgue. Mauricio orders Chávez to arrest Hidalgo.

episodes.name: Episode 19
episodes.overview: El Buitre makes Victoria an offer to get her to hand Diego over. She and Inés are a thorn in Mateo's side. Circe goes after Ricas to find Hidalgo.

episodes.name: Episode 20
episodes.overview: Circe detains Diego and finds his weak spot: his family. Taking advantage of this, she leaves him in an abandoned warehouse, with a gun and a choice.

episodes.name: Episode 21
episodes.overview: Nana, Circe, Apá and El Buitre make an unplanned pact. Mami Chula's reputation as a dangerous traitor is indisputable. Ricas and Diego mourn a loss.

episodes.name: Episode 22
episodes.overview: El Buitre's suspicions are confirmed and Diego is involved. A confession unleashes a beating and Circe is exposed. Hidalgo has important information.

episodes.name: Episodio  23
episodes.overview: Mateo's leadership is at risk, so Mauricio launches a campaign against the huachicoleros and their leader. Enraged, El Buitre responds in cold blood.

episodes.name: Episodio 24
episodes.overview: Mateo isn't sure how much Isabel knew about Diego. Amanda asks questions. Her grandfather vows to bring Ricas in and keep the enemy from sinking him.

episodes.name: Episode 25
episodes.overview: Mateo tries to make the most of his final goodbye to Isabel. Amanda vows to find the person responsible for her mother's death.

episodes.name: Episode 26
episodes.overview: Victoria tells Diego he is putting custody of Ricas at risk. Diego is ready to find crucial evidence. A wedding abroad proves convenient for Mateo.

episodes.name: Episode 27
episodes.overview: Amanda is unafraid and determined to go after her grandfather's enemy. Everyone is looking for Ricas and believes that Corona took him by force.

episodes.name: Episode 28
episodes.overview: Diego and Mateo come before the judge to air their grievances. Victoria tries to control her client. Mateo shines as the concerned grandfather.

episodes.name: Episode 29
episodes.overview: Diego and his followers must train and procure weapons. Victoria leads Hidalgo to an impressive hidden arsenal. Joselito plays dirty with Circe.

episodes.name: Episode 30
episodes.overview: Mateo tries to bribe Judge Sequeira to win custody of his grandchildren; the scales begin to tip in his favor. Father Rafael takes Lamas from school.

episodes.name: Episode 31
episodes.overview: Jaimito and Ignacio risk everything and go to Mateo's hacienda. Patricia and Rubén are ready to take Fernanda to the hospital, but things go awry.

episodes.name: Episode 32
episodes.overview: Salas challenges Mateo and warns him that someday he will pay for everything. Corona thinks about Fernanda. Rubén winds up as an unwilling accomplice.

episodes.name: Episode 33
episodes.overview: Victoria sees Diego as the man who pushes her to fight for her ideals. Someone who gives people hope. She has never met anyone like him before.

episodes.name: Episode 34
episodes.overview: Victoria recognizes Jaimito in one of Joselito's publications. Now that they know about the plan to rescue Fernanda, maybe they could find Salas.

episodes.name: Episode 35
episodes.overview: Amanda sees Benito, and Mateo takes matters into his own hands. A lie comes to light, and suspicion of a betrayal brings serious consequences.

episodes.name: Episode 36
episodes.overview: Mateo now sees how to end the war with the Arismendi family: by trading Circe for El Cachorro. Claudio vows to turn Mateo's hacienda into a graveyard.

episodes.name: Episode 37
episodes.overview: Mateo loses control. Lupe becomes nervous and Victoria offers to take Alberto far away, but he thinks of the consequences. Everyone is under threat.

episodes.name: Episode 38
episodes.overview: After Salas's statement, Diego organizes a rescue. Victoria tells him to bring Lupe and Alberto. El Buitre learns of the plan involving El Cachorro.

episodes.name: Episode 39
episodes.overview: If Fernanda talks, Mateo will go to jail. Chávez is ordered to find her as soon as possible. Even if Rafael wanted to help, it would be very risky.

episodes.name: Episode 40
episodes.overview: Diego does not believe the police, but he knows that Victoria trusts Bracho, so together they devise a plan that could cost them dearly.

episodes.name: Episode 41
episodes.overview: Victoria is worried, so Diego calls Mateo and makes a promise. Bracho starts to build the case and thinks of a trustworthy prosecutor.

episodes.name: Episode 42
episodes.overview: Fernanda is ready to see Salas, with the help of Father Rafael and a strategy that seeks to mislead everyone. Chávez takes statements at the hospital.

episodes.name: Episode 43
episodes.overview: Diego and Ricas want to see Amanda and file an injunction against Mateo. Corona bans her from seeing her stepfather and brother. No one will concede.

episodes.name: Episode 44
episodes.overview: Mateo discovers Diego's self-defense group and attacks, convinced that striking first gives him an advantage. Frida is the bait for Hidalgo's gang.

episodes.name: Episode 45
episodes.overview: Victoria gathers enough information to blackmail The Man and gets the coordinates to bring back Nuria and Frida. Diego tries to intervene.

episodes.name: Episode 46
episodes.overview: The judge has made a decision on custody of the Corona siblings. Victoria, Diego and Fuentes await a verdict that will mark a before and after.

episodes.name: Episode 47
episodes.overview: Diego convinces Ricas there's only one way to stop Mateo from taking him. As Victoria says goodbye, she receives an unexpected message from Alberto.

episodes.name: Episode 48
episodes.overview: Several things surprise Ricas on arriving at Mateo's hacienda. Amanda sheds tears of regret, makes a call from the heart, and fearfully asks for help.

episodes.name: Episode 49
episodes.overview: Mateo's men surprise Diego and Apá. War with the Arismendi family looms; Corona already has a strategy. Victoria enlists a doctor as an accomplice.

episodes.name: Episode 50
episodes.overview: Victoria cannot believe that Diego would consider allying with El Apá. During a heated argument, she gives him a warning. Then everything changes.

episodes.name: Episode 51
episodes.overview: Mateo threatens Father Rafael, asking Mauricio to expel him from the country since he is a hindrance. The search for Salas and Bracho intensifies.

episodes.name: Episode 52
episodes.overview: In a desperate attempt to reach the hideout where Bracho took Salas, Diego and Deivid confront a patrol car and become involved in a shootout.

episodes.name: Episode 53
episodes.overview: Tired of being in hiding, Fernanda ignores Diego's advice and goes to the hospital to see Salas. Mateo finds out and sets a life or death ultimatum.

episodes.name: Episode 54
episodes.overview: Chucho and Diego have a man-to-man discussion. Hidalgo realizes that money can undermine loyalty. Fernanda is very worried.

episodes.name: Episode 55
episodes.overview: Diego goes to "turn himself in" to El Buitre while Circe attends to business matters with Nana and Jaimito, unaware that someone is stalking them.

episodes.name: Episode 56
episodes.overview: Diego confirms to Deivid that he is allied with El Buitre, but doesn't tell Victoria. He knows joining the Arismendis could ruin their relationship.

episodes.name: Episode 57
episodes.overview: Now, El Apá's life is worth three, as the exchange includes Circe, Diego, and the counterfeiter Jaimito. Mateo's enemies devise a rescue plan.

episodes.name: Episode 58
episodes.overview: Both sides will give their all on a decisive night. Victoria puts into action a bold new strategy to attack Mateo's criminal network from the inside.

episodes.name: Episode 59
episodes.overview: Fernanda manipulates the situation to protect Diego and he is completely bewildered. Hidalgo looks for Victoria, but doesn't find her.

episodes.name: Episode 60
episodes.overview: Humberto gives Jaime a photo of Valentina Acosta, a supposed friend of Victoria's, so that he can falsify her identity. Diego is suspicious.

episodes.name: Episode 61
episodes.overview: The Man must make good on the deal and help Victoria. Mateo will oversee that group of immigrants, so there's more risk, but she goes through with it.

episodes.name: Episode 62
episodes.overview: The Man does his job and Victoria is left alone, not knowing what will become of her. Diego confesses to Father Rafael, who tells him about Victoria.

episodes.name: Episode 63
episodes.overview: Chávez launches an operation and El Buitre abandons a funeral in full swing. A chase ensues and Circe tries to vanish into the cemetery.

episodes.name: Episode 64
episodes.overview: Now that Victoria is on the inside of organized crime, The Man drugs her to entrap her in prostitution. Diego confronts Humberto about Lamas.

episodes.name: Episode 65
episodes.overview: The police go to the bar where Mateo runs his business. Victoria could testify, but she can't talk. El Míster bribes the authorities to drop the case.

episodes.name: Episode 66
episodes.overview: Diego hears a name and takes the risk of looking for information about Victoria. Meanwhile, Mateo strives to find out who she is and what she wants.

episodes.name: Episode 67
episodes.overview: Victoria confronts her kidnapper, warning him not to kill her. Seeking evidence against Mateo, she confides in Nuria, who tells El Míster the truth.

episodes.name: Episode 68
episodes.overview: Hearing gunshots on a call, Diego urges Humberto to tell him where Victoria is. Disguised as Valentina, the lawyer discovers hell in the maquilas.

episodes.name: Episode 69
episodes.overview: On Victoria's trail, Diego and Deivid arrive at a bar. No one recognizes her, but one of the girls mentions that there's a brave lawyer among them.

episodes.name: Episode 70
episodes.overview: Mateo proposes a pact and summons El Buitre alone, in secret, and unarmed. Diego senses something is off. Victoria recognizes him and tells Nuria.

episodes.name: Episode 71
episodes.overview: Victoria's mission becomes more difficult when she suspects that Diego is part of the plan. She takes measures after talking to her accomplice.

episodes.name: Episode 72
episodes.overview: Help capturing Mateo isn't enough. Handing him over to the authorities is no guarantee he'll be locked up for life, so Diego proposes an alternative.

episodes.name: Episode 73
episodes.overview: Fixated on her goal, Victoria informs the authorities she's no longer alone. Diego vows to rescue her, sending her a message through Nuria.

episodes.name: Episode 74
episodes.overview: El Míster fears for the safety of his children, so Victoria offers him a way to protect them. A secret meeting exceeds the limits of the mission.

episodes.name: Episode 75
episodes.overview: Fernanda implements her plan and distracts Mateo with her charms. Alberto, Ricas and Amanda escape, but the border crossing is too busy.

episodes.name: Episode 76
episodes.overview: A risky escape attempt puts Fernanda in danger. Victoria and Nuria rely on The Man to steal more evidence that compromises Mateo.

episodes.name: Episode 77
episodes.overview: On Mateo's orders, Darwin threatens Victoria and El Míster at gunpoint. Diego, the federal agent, and team go after them. Ramona makes an accusation.

episodes.name: Episode 78
episodes.overview: A dossier with ironclad evidence doesn't seem to be enough to arrest Corona. A biased judge and government involvement lead Diego to confront Mateo.

episodes.name: Episode 79
episodes.overview: Circe learns that Vidal is in jail and decides to take his money; going after Ramona, she has an unexpected reunion. El Buitre gets even with Jaimito.

episodes.name: Episode 80
episodes.overview: Victoria believes they only have what Chucho was able to get out of Vidal in prison, but there is overwhelming evidence.

2.name: Season 2
2.overview: When Fernanda is abducted and Amanda runs away to Mexico, Isabel and Diego must leave their new life in witness protection in the U.S. to get them back.

candidates.name: False Flag
candidates.overview: The series, loosely based on the true story of the assassination in Dubai of a senior Hamas official Mahmoud al-Mabhouh - the co-founder of military wing of the Islamist Palestinian group Hamas on 19 January 2010, revolves around five ordinary Israeli citizens who discover one morning via the media that they are the principal suspects of a high-profile kidnapping and are implicated as culprits in the kidnapping.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: The Iranian Defense Minister is abducted in Moscow in a covert operation that is attributed to the Israeli Mossad. Five Israeli civilians wake in the morning and discover that their passports have been used by the abductors.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: The four suspects - Ben Refael, Anna Lipman, Natali Alfasia and Asia Brindech - are being investigated by the Shin Bet, in order to determine their involvement in the abduction of the Iranian minister. The fifth suspect, Shawn Tilson, tries to avoid capture

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: The four detainees are being released home but remain under surveillance, all while the Shin Bet don't believe them and the people close to them start to get suspicious. What are they hiding?

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: Natali is arrested once again. She cooperates with Eitan, the Shin Bet team leader and tells him everything. Asia discovers the truth about her connection to the case.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: With the noose tightening around their necks, the suspects make a critical decision that will change everything.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: During a launch ceremony, an oil pump line between Israel and Turkey mysteriously explodes. Three Israelis become suspects suspects of global terror.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: Shin Bet investigators arrive to the suspects homes to interrogate their close ones. Even in the best families lies are being told and secrets are kept.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: Dikla is released to house arrest. Mika is fired from the Ministry of Health. Sago suspects his wife is having an affair again while the searches for Anat and Amir end empty handed.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: Miriam is abducted while attempting to help Dikla. The mutual concern for Miriam breaks the ice between Dikla and her father after 8 years. Amir crosses the border back to Israel under disguise and tries to contact Mika. Anat returns to Israel and instructs her family to flee.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: Anat and Amir find a new suspect and try to understand her connection to the explosion. Amir's photo is published by the media and Mika is named "a terrorist's partner".

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: Anat and Amir decide to send the Moscow documents to Eitan. Eitan returns to HQ and finds out a war on Hezbollah is about to embark.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: Minister Marom claims Eitan's documents are forged. The Mossad is taken off the investigation and Eitan is put on leave, but refuses to stop his search for Amor and Anat.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: The engagement party turn into a nightmare at sea.

episodes.name: Episode 9
episodes.overview: The truth is revealed.

2.name: Season 2
2.overview: New Season — New Story: the lives of three families fall apart when they discover their loved ones are missing after a mysterious bombing.

selected.name: Bitten
selected.overview: Elena Micheals thought she left the world of supernatural behind when she left Stonehaven behind 'for good this time' she thought. Until the night she got the mysterious call from her pack leader asking her to come back. So now she is heading back, leaving her life as a normal photographer in Toronto for the moment to re-enter the world of werewolves, rules about protect the pack and a man she has spent years trying to get out of her system. Oh and did she mention she was the only living female werewolf in existence?

episodes.name: Summons
episodes.overview: A supernatural thriller about the lone female werewolf in existence begins when Elena is forced to leave the perfect life she has made for herself as a photographer in Toronto to return to Upstate New York after her wolf pack is threatened.

episodes.name: Prodigal
episodes.overview: Clay makes it clear to Elena that he's still very much interested in her, but she keeps her distance, focusing her attention on tracking the killer "mutt" and getting back to her human life in Toronto. However, the discovery of a second body on Stonehaven property keeps the prodigal werewolf in Upstate New York indefinitely.

episodes.name: Trespass
episodes.overview: Old feelings come to surface for Elena and Clay, who find themselves in a dangerous situation when they track the Mutt to a warehouse and he turns into a wolf.

episodes.name: Grief
episodes.overview: Elena and Clay deal with their growing sexual tension as they work together to figure out the who and why behind the plot to turn psychotic killers into werewolves.

episodes.name: Bitten
episodes.overview: Elena is overwhelmed with memories of her romance with Clay, including the day she was bitten by a werewolf, as she defends him against murder accusations; at the same time, Clay's character is put into question when former Pack member Daniel Santos shows up with information on the Mutt uprising.

episodes.name: Committed
episodes.overview: Elena returns to Toronto, but her human life with Philip is interrupted when Santos arrives with a way out of the Pack. Elsewhere, at Stonehaven, Jeremy must fight to keep his Alpha status in tact.

episodes.name: Stalking
episodes.overview: Daniel Santos, the recently revealed leader of the Mutt uprising, wants to sit down with the Pack and discuss a truce. But are they just walking into a trap?

episodes.name: Prisoner
episodes.overview: A poisoned Jeremy grows weaker by the hour as Elena and Clay race against the clock to save his life, but run into hurdles as they interrogate a Mutt and contend with a werewolf wannabe.

episodes.name: Vengeance
episodes.overview: The Pack push personal issues aside to focus on survival after Santos sics a notorious killer on them, but Elena's feelings for Clay race to the surface after her own close call with death.

episodes.name: Descent
episodes.overview: Elena returns to Toronto for her art show accompanied by Clay, who keeps a protective watch over her while camping out on Philip's couch. Elsewhere, the Pack receive valuable information about the Mutts from an unexpected source.

episodes.name: Settling
episodes.overview: Elena enters into damage-control mode with Philip, who has become painfully aware of her romantic history with Clay; and later, breaks Pack law when the Mutts launch a coordinated attack in Toronto and threaten the human she loves.

episodes.name: Caged
episodes.overview: Elena goes against her Alpha's commands when she embraces her killer instinct to free Clay from captivity. Later, when confronted by Phillip, she's forced to come to terms with her true identity.

episodes.name: Ready
episodes.overview: In the Season 1 finale, Elena returns to Stonehaven and her Pack after learning the truth about Clay's role in her werewolf origins. Reunited, they ready themselves for an epic war against the Mutt army led by Santos and the mysterious James Williams.

1.name: Season 1
1.overview: When a dead girl is discovered in the woods outside the town of Bear Valley (the adopted home of The Pack), it’s the genesis of an all-out war against a rogue group of Mutts (non-Pack werewolves) whose aim is to destroy The Pack. Torn between the new life she’s created in Toronto and loyalty to her Pack family, Elena will fight her own battle between the woman, and the wolf within.

episodes.name: Bad Blood
episodes.overview: Elena and The Pack are on the hunt for Malcolm. Meanwhile, back at Stonehaven, Jeremy receives an ultimatum from the Council of International Alphas that challenges his leadership over North America.

episodes.name: Scare Tactics
episodes.overview: Clay investigates a mysterious symbol that may be related to witchcraft while the rest of The Pack interrogates a captive Malcolm. However, when both inquiries lead to the same destination, The Pack is faced with a disturbing truth – witches live among us.

episodes.name: Hell's Teeth
episodes.overview: When a new threat proves to be more powerful than anticipated, both The Pack and Coven suffer heavy losses in the confrontation.

episodes.name: Dead Meat
episodes.overview: Elena awakens to find herself the subject of painful tests in a hidden compound run by a maniacal and powerful cult leader. Meanwhile, The Pack and witches must resort to dark magic in an effort to track down their missing members.

episodes.name: Rabbit Hole
episodes.overview: In order to stay alive, Elena must guide Dr. Bauer through her first Change as The Pack and Coven try to figure out who Aleister is, and where his compound is located.

episodes.name: Nine Circles
episodes.overview: Aleister casts a mind-bending spell on Elena, forcing her into a battle against her own dark fears and demons. Meanwhile, Rachael is locked in a cage with Logan, struggling to come to terms with what he is. In a nearby forest, Clay and Paige must overcome their personal differences in order to find Aleister’s compound.

episodes.name: Bad Dreams
episodes.overview: When the new Spanish Alpha tries to blackmail Jeremy into murdering the Russian Alpha, the Pack has things under control until a surprise visit from Savannah upends their plans. Nick and Paige try to secretly meet Nick's mother.

episodes.name: Dark Arts
episodes.overview: Having possessed Clay’s body, Aleister returns to Stonehaven where he creates ideal conditions to abduct Savannah. Meanwhile, Clay finds himself trapped in his unconscious, wrestling with both the occupying Aleister and his own mind in a way that could destroy him.

episodes.name: Scavenger's Daughter
episodes.overview: Rachel and Logan battle their own demons as Aleister’s Undoing takes hold of the witches and has unexpected consequences for the wolves. The Pack and the Coven do their best to defeat him before sunrise—when life as they know it will change forever if Aleister and Clara get their way. A reluctant Ruth resorts to Left Hand magic to fight her son while a surprise ally appears to offer help to Jeremy and his Pack.

episodes.name: Fine Temporum
episodes.overview: Elena and The Pack storm the Delphi building to save Savannah, the witches, and the werewolves in a final showdown against Aleister and Clara.

episodes.name: Family, Of Sorts
episodes.overview: In order to solidify his power, a war hardened Jeremy has tasked Elena, Clay and Nick with recruiting all North American Mutts into the Pack. Meanwhile, Elena is accosted by mysterious new characters who challenge her with a surprising claim.

episodes.name: Our Own Blood
episodes.overview: Elena struggles to deal with a new discovery about her past. Clay readies Stonehaven for a possible attack from the Spanish by calling in new Pack members. Meanwhile, Jeremy and Nick find a clue at the Spanish hideout that ultimately leads to them rushing back to Stonehaven.

episodes.name: Right Behind You
episodes.overview: Elena struggles to convince Jeremy to protect her blood family against the Russia Alpha; Nick uncovers Roman's plans.

episodes.name: A Quiet Dog
episodes.overview: Jeremy attempts to broker a negotiation to end the thirty-year blood feud between Sasha and Roman. Meanwhile, Elena watches over Pack prisoner, Konstantin, who tries to deduce why she is protecting Sasha.

episodes.name: Of Sonders Weight
episodes.overview: Jeremy deals with fallout from the failed negotiations between Sasha and Roman; Elena attends to an injured Sasha; Clay and Alexei track down the victim of a young wolf's attack.

episodes.name: Rule of Anger
episodes.overview: Elena and Clay take on a deadly new foe to save Marsten; Paige and Nick try to find the cause of Rocco's magical outbreaks; Katia tries to save her family.

episodes.name: On the Brink
episodes.overview: Nick, Paige and Rachel track Katia with magic; Elena invites Konstantin to Stonehaven and asks for his help; Clay and Jorge keep an eye on the Albino.

episodes.name: Tili Tili Bom
episodes.overview: As the Alpha, Elena sets out with Clay to take down the Albino; Nick and Katia are captured by Roman's henchmen; Jeremy gets help from a surprising ally in his quest to kill Roman.

episodes.name: Shock the System
episodes.overview: When Elena tries to comfort a grieving Sasha, they get lured into the woods and are taken prisoner by the Albino; Jeremy wages psychological warfare against his captor; Clay, Nick and Alexei race to save a new Alpha.

episodes.name: Truth, Changes, Everything
episodes.overview: Elena comes up with a dangerous plan to take back Stonehaven, save the Pack, and change everything forever.
