episodes.overview: Elena is overwhelmed with memories of her romance with Clay, including the day she was bitten by a werewolf, as she defends him against murder accusations; at the same time, Clay's character is put into question when former Pack member Daniel Santos shows up with information on the Mutt uprising.

episodes.name: Committed
episodes.overview: Elena returns to Toronto, but her human life with Philip is interrupted when Santos arrives with a way out of the Pack. Elsewhere, at Stonehaven, Jeremy must fight to keep his Alpha status in tact.

episodes.name: Stalking
episodes.overview: Daniel Santos, the recently revealed leader of the Mutt uprising, wants to sit down with the Pack and discuss a truce. But are they just walking into a trap?

episodes.name: Prisoner
episodes.overview: A poisoned Jeremy grows weaker by the hour as Elena and Clay race against the clock to save his life, but run into hurdles as they interrogate a Mutt and contend with a werewolf wannabe.

episodes.name: Vengeance
episodes.overview: The Pack push personal issues aside to focus on survival after Santos sics a notorious killer on them, but Elena's feelings for Clay race to the surface after her own close call with death.

episodes.name: Descent
episodes.overview: Elena returns to Toronto for her art show accompanied by Clay, who keeps a protective watch over her while camping out on Philip's couch. Elsewhere, the Pack receive valuable information about the Mutts from an unexpected source.

episodes.name: Settling
episodes.overview: Elena enters into damage-control mode with Philip, who has become painfully aware of her romantic history with Clay; and later, breaks Pack law when the Mutts launch a coordinated attack in Toronto and threaten the human she loves.

episodes.name: Caged
episodes.overview: Elena goes against her Alpha's commands when she embraces her killer instinct to free Clay from captivity. Later, when confronted by Phillip, she's forced to come to terms with her true identity.

episodes.name: Ready
episodes.overview: In the Season 1 finale, Elena returns to Stonehaven and her Pack after learning the truth about Clay's role in her werewolf origins. Reunited, they ready themselves for an epic war against the Mutt army led by Santos and the mysterious James Williams.

1.name: Season 1
1.overview: When a dead girl is discovered in the woods outside the town of Bear Valley (the adopted home of The Pack), it’s the genesis of an all-out war against a rogue group of Mutts (non-Pack werewolves) whose aim is to destroy The Pack. Torn between the new life she’s created in Toronto and loyalty to her Pack family, Elena will fight her own battle between the woman, and the wolf within.

episodes.name: Bad Blood
episodes.overview: Elena and The Pack are on the hunt for Malcolm. Meanwhile, back at Stonehaven, Jeremy receives an ultimatum from the Council of International Alphas that challenges his leadership over North America.

episodes.name: Scare Tactics
episodes.overview: Clay investigates a mysterious symbol that may be related to witchcraft while the rest of The Pack interrogates a captive Malcolm. However, when both inquiries lead to the same destination, The Pack is faced with a disturbing truth – witches live among us.

episodes.name: Hell's Teeth
episodes.overview: When a new threat proves to be more powerful than anticipated, both The Pack and Coven suffer heavy losses in the confrontation.

episodes.name: Dead Meat
episodes.overview: Elena awakens to find herself the subject of painful tests in a hidden compound run by a maniacal and powerful cult leader. Meanwhile, The Pack and witches must resort to dark magic in an effort to track down their missing members.

episodes.name: Rabbit Hole
episodes.overview: In order to stay alive, Elena must guide Dr. Bauer through her first Change as The Pack and Coven try to figure out who Aleister is, and where his compound is located.

episodes.name: Nine Circles
episodes.overview: Aleister casts a mind-bending spell on Elena, forcing her into a battle against her own dark fears and demons. Meanwhile, Rachael is locked in a cage with Logan, struggling to come to terms with what he is. In a nearby forest, Clay and Paige must overcome their personal differences in order to find Aleister’s compound.

episodes.name: Bad Dreams
episodes.overview: When the new Spanish Alpha tries to blackmail Jeremy into murdering the Russian Alpha, the Pack has things under control until a surprise visit from Savannah upends their plans. Nick and Paige try to secretly meet Nick's mother.

episodes.name: Dark Arts
episodes.overview: Having possessed Clay’s body, Aleister returns to Stonehaven where he creates ideal conditions to abduct Savannah. Meanwhile, Clay finds himself trapped in his unconscious, wrestling with both the occupying Aleister and his own mind in a way that could destroy him.

episodes.name: Scavenger's Daughter
episodes.overview: Rachel and Logan battle their own demons as Aleister’s Undoing takes hold of the witches and has unexpected consequences for the wolves. The Pack and the Coven do their best to defeat him before sunrise—when life as they know it will change forever if Aleister and Clara get their way. A reluctant Ruth resorts to Left Hand magic to fight her son while a surprise ally appears to offer help to Jeremy and his Pack.

episodes.name: Fine Temporum
episodes.overview: Elena and The Pack storm the Delphi building to save Savannah, the witches, and the werewolves in a final showdown against Aleister and Clara.

episodes.name: Family, Of Sorts
episodes.overview: In order to solidify his power, a war hardened Jeremy has tasked Elena, Clay and Nick with recruiting all North American Mutts into the Pack. Meanwhile, Elena is accosted by mysterious new characters who challenge her with a surprising claim.

episodes.name: Our Own Blood
episodes.overview: Elena struggles to deal with a new discovery about her past. Clay readies Stonehaven for a possible attack from the Spanish by calling in new Pack members. Meanwhile, Jeremy and Nick find a clue at the Spanish hideout that ultimately leads to them rushing back to Stonehaven.

episodes.name: Right Behind You
episodes.overview: Elena struggles to convince Jeremy to protect her blood family against the Russia Alpha; Nick uncovers Roman's plans.

episodes.name: A Quiet Dog
episodes.overview: Jeremy attempts to broker a negotiation to end the thirty-year blood feud between Sasha and Roman. Meanwhile, Elena watches over Pack prisoner, Konstantin, who tries to deduce why she is protecting Sasha.

episodes.name: Of Sonders Weight
episodes.overview: Jeremy deals with fallout from the failed negotiations between Sasha and Roman; Elena attends to an injured Sasha; Clay and Alexei track down the victim of a young wolf's attack.

episodes.name: Rule of Anger
episodes.overview: Elena and Clay take on a deadly new foe to save Marsten; Paige and Nick try to find the cause of Rocco's magical outbreaks; Katia tries to save her family.

episodes.name: On the Brink
episodes.overview: Nick, Paige and Rachel track Katia with magic; Elena invites Konstantin to Stonehaven and asks for his help; Clay and Jorge keep an eye on the Albino.

episodes.name: Tili Tili Bom
episodes.overview: As the Alpha, Elena sets out with Clay to take down the Albino; Nick and Katia are captured by Roman's henchmen; Jeremy gets help from a surprising ally in his quest to kill Roman.

episodes.name: Shock the System
episodes.overview: When Elena tries to comfort a grieving Sasha, they get lured into the woods and are taken prisoner by the Albino; Jeremy wages psychological warfare against his captor; Clay, Nick and Alexei race to save a new Alpha.

episodes.name: Truth, Changes, Everything
episodes.overview: Elena comes up with a dangerous plan to take back Stonehaven, save the Pack, and change everything forever.

candidates.name: The Biter Bitten
candidates.overview:
A treasure is hidden inside a circus.

One step closer to the treasure; one step closer to danger.

Ten Tigers, the gang who used to rob on the horseback, was arrested a few decades ago. A legend saying that a treasure was buried in Panyu by the Tigers pasted on ever after.

An antique from the Qing Dynasty is excavated during the construction work for the expansion of the Fei Cheung Zoo in Panyu. It is later verified as part of the legendary Ten Tigers’ treasure. A foreign investor sends an archaeological professor and his grandson HO CHUNG FUNG (CHAN HO MAN, BENNY) to search for the rest of the hidden treasure in order to protect these national relics. After the news of their expedition spreads, different people get interested in the treasure...

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: HO TSUN-FUNG and his friend CHEUNG KIN-SING return to Hong Kong for their holiday after their graduation from an American university. FUNG is best known for his wit and intelligence. His mother SHUM SIN-LING wants him to stay in Hong Kong and develop his career while his grandfather HO CHING-HUNG expects him to go to Panyu, China so that he can help oversee the daily operation of the family-owned garment factory. SING’s uncle PANG LAI-SHUN is the Chief Manager of a zoo run by HUNG. He thinks it would be great if SING could join the zoo and work along with him. Despite the persuasion of their relatives, FUNG and SING have decided to return to the States. FUNG and SING go to the zoo in Panyu for a visit, during which a little white tiger is found to have gone missing. FUNG suspects that the white tiger has been stolen by certain members of the circus which are hired to perform in the zoo……

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: Given that it is a national treasure, HUNG decides to return the bronze dog to the Chinese government. He supports the search for the rest of the bronze animals and MAN is appointed to take charge of this research project. YEE and his boyfriend NG YUN-SANG pick a quarrel with FUNG and SING when they are carrying excavation work in the zoo. Not wanting to mess with YEE, FUNG prefers to settle the dispute as soon as possible. HUNG sets FUNG a series of riddles but FUNG manages to solve the questions one by one. Now HUNG is left with no excuse to make him stay in Panyu. Realizing that HUNG has grown into a frail old man, FUNG finally offers to stay in Panyu. But to HUNG’s surprise, FUNG is not going to join the garment factory. What he really wants is to follow SING to the zoo and work as an Assistant Manager. FUNG and SING trespass on the acrobatic troupe’s secret training corner, and LAM is once again enraged……

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: The people in the photo could be the Ten Tigers of Panyu. FUNG tries to find out how these people may look in their old age by using advanced computer technology. He also examines the photo very closely hoping to find some clues from the antiques in the picture. TAN was brought up by LAM’s family. She grew up with LAM and they refer to each other as brother as sister. TAN is appointed to perform a difficult stunt, which irks another acrobatic troupe member YIN KA-PIK. TAN and some other troupe members are sexually harassed by a group of gangsters in a pub. FUNG and SING who are nearby fly off to save the girls from the predicament. A girl called MAY comes to Panyu to look for SANG. FUNG spots the pair and suspects that they are carrying an affair. FUNG and SING find the mobile phone left behind by SANG, in which a lot of love codes from MAY have been saved. YEE has faith in SANG and blames FUNG and SING for being too nosy……

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: FUNG tricks MAY into appearing. MAY reveals that she has had an affair with SANG for three years and that she has got pregnant with his child. According to her confession, it was her who splashed YEE with glue. YEE is shocked to learn the truth. SANG places the responsibility onto YEE and is resolved to break up with her, which comes as a huge blow to the girl. PIK who is jealous of TAN and her amazing performance frames her for theft. But FUNG is so level-headed that he can eventually prove TAN’s innocence. TAN is however delayed by this incident. LAM is enraged by her lateness and decides to find someone else to replace her in the coming acrobatic show. CHAT reveals to FUNG and YEE the secrets of the Buddha statue although he knows from the very start that the pair are not his next of kin. CHAT used to be a servant for the Third Tiger, a member of the notorious Ten Tigers of Panyu, from whom he heard a lot about robbers……

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: SING has produced a DVD to express his love for TAN. This has been discovered by some acrobatic troupe members and the news soon reaches LAM. LAM is so angry that he gives SING a hard punch. Despite his decision to punish TAN, LAM is actually very concerned about her. Another troupe member SUNG MIU-SZ realizes that LAM has a special affection for TAN, about which she is a little upset. TAN only sees SING as a friend, and to avoid any further misunderstanding, she asks FUNG to relay the message to him. Knowing that the zoo is going to hire another acrobatic troupe, SING is so worried about TAN’s future and flies off to tell her the news. FUNG hints to SING that TAN has no feeling for him but SING does not seem to get the message. MAN and FUNG discover that the treasures may have something to do with Taiji. FUNG then decides to consult HUNG who knows a lot about Taiji……

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: The silver egg is an artifact from the eighteenth century. A tiger-shaped pattern is carved on its bottom, which sounds so puzzling to MAN and FUNG. To put on a good show, TAN has spent a lot of time in intensive training, which gives her a number of bruises and wounds. LING gets along well with YEE. To show her support to the girl, LING not only addresses YEE as FUNG’s girlfriend but also buys her a ring as a gift. To FUNG, it is really a nasty trick but he just cannot help it. The tiger-shaped pattern on the silver egg is the symbol of the Ten Tigers but FUNG is absolutely clueless about the relationship between the symbol and the treasures. The Program Manager of the zoo YIU KWOK-KUEN brings a herd of monkeys to the acrobatic troupe’s training corner and throws the place into chaos right afterwards. FUNG manages to drive KUEN off by stratagem but SING points out to TAN that it is he himself who should get the credit……

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: TAN seems to have lost all confidence in herself. LAM and FUNG try to help her regain her confidence with different approaches. FUNG and YEE have an argument again, during which he mocks her for being dumped and even calls her mad and insane. YEE is enraged while FUNG is also sorry for what he has said. YEE points out that SING has an obvious affection for TAN, so TAN decides to turn him down in a clear way. SING is disappointed to learn about the truth but is still happy to be considered a friend of TAN. SING and YEE have a drinking competition. SING is defeated while YEE is also as drunk as a skunk. Feeling that it will be too dangerous to leave the drunken YEE in the street over the night, FUNG offers to send her home. The next day when she wakes up, YEE is very much afraid that she has been raped by FUNG but she soon finds out that it is just a misunderstanding……

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: Granny SAM finally awakes from unconsciousness. She feels a little offended when she knows that FUNG and his mates are from Hong Kong. Having learnt about their motive, she refuses to say a word about the jade pendant. FUNG guesses that Granny SAM is from the village nearby. To probe more deeply, he cycles to the village with YEE to have a look. The village chief there reveals that Granny SAM was in league with the Ten Tigers to raid their place. As YEE and FUNG are trying to dig out the truth from Granny SAM, TAN turns up suddenly. TAN is not happy with FUNG and his mates whom, according to her, have been trying to con Granny SAM. CHI purposely damages the boat which carries TAN and SING so that they can never get back to the shore……

episodes.name: Episode 9
episodes.overview: According to Granny SAM, the Fourth Tiger mistakenly believed that the villagers had killed his mother and it was deep hatred in his heart which drove him to become a robber and a member of the Ten Tigers. To seek revenge, he came back to rob his village and took Granny SAM away. The other nine Tigers insisted on killing all the women they had kidnapped. To save Granny SAM, the Fourth Tiger had no choice but to pretend to kill her. Before he left, he asked her to wait for his return. Years went by but the Fourth Tiger did not show up. Feeling so disappointed, Granny SAM decided to marry TAN’s grandfather, who was her benefactor. A year later, Granny SAM met the Fourth Tiger again. The Fourth Tiger passed her the jade pendant and assured her that he would come back again no matter what. MAN tells her that the Ten Tigers have all been executed but Granny SAM remains steadfast in her belief that the Fourth Tiger will be back some day……

episodes.name: Episode 10
episodes.overview: Granny SAM’s operation turns out to be very successful. She knows from the right beginning that the Fourth Tiger has not left her any message. Despite this, she is still grateful to everyone who has helped her get over her psychological distress. TAN and FUNG go and buy some new bedroom curtains for Granny SAM. Afterwards, they go back home together on the same bicycle like a sweet couple. FUNG falls from a height. TAN tries to soothe his bruise with a boiled egg, during which both of them can feel a special affection for each other. FUNG, SING, TAN and YEE go and make a wish respectively. FUNG suspects that the silver and golden eggs have been booby-trapped. LING becomes more and more fond of YEE and even asks the girl to give her a massage. LAM blames TAN for staying too long with FUNG and SING in her hometown. He punishes TAN and TAN promises to concentrate more on training……

episodes.name: Episode 11
episodes.overview: With the clue left in the sword, FUNG manages to find the tomb of the Second Tiger. FUNG takes a photo of the tomb and shows it to SHUN who is a feng shui professional. Having studied the photo for a while, SHUN points out that the feng shui arrangement of the tomb is to make people as contented as they can be. SHUN predicts that SING will fall in love with someone from an exotic place by the end of the year. YEE would like to know if she is the one for FUNG but she has mistakenly taken SING’s birth details for fortune-telling. The divine results make her believe that she and FUNG are a perfect match made in heaven. Fearing that TAN will sooner or later outshine her, PIK makes a deliberate decision to embarrass TAN. LAM points out that there is no team spirit in the troupe and for this reason, all troupe members will have to be punished. MAN has a scan of the eggs and is shocked to discover that there are some liquid explosives inside……

episodes.name: Episode 12
episodes.overview: A piece of silk cloth from the 1930s/1940s is found inside the sword. On the cloth are a few ink stains, making it look like a star map. FUNG suspects that someone has deliberately let him find the sword. In fact it is KWAN’s idea to get someone to pose as the Second Tiger’s descendant so that FUNG will have the clue to unravel the secrets of the sword. TAN gets aware that YEE is in love with FUNG and she is so pleased for her. KUEN wants to take a peek of TAN who is getting changed but he ends up catching a fleeting glimpse of PIK instead. PIK has injured her elbow so TAN is called in to replace her. FUNG sends TAN a greeting card to wish her success in her performance, which gives TAN a great thrill. LAM, however, has deep reservations about FUNG’s motive. PIK claims that TAN has replaced her medicines with something else, which accounts for why she is getting weaker and weaker……

episodes.name: Episode 13
episodes.overview: FUNG has been keeping a close eye on CHI and he believes that there must be someone out there to head the plot. He has moved the sword and the map to a safer place so what CHI has stolen is just an empty box. PIK slaps TAN on the face and the rest of the troupe members go on to blame TAN for causing so much trouble. Almost everyone is trying to isolate her. SZ asks FUNG to give TAN a helping hand and FUNG discovers that it is not PIK but someone else who is framing TAN. PIK says that TAN is a loose woman who has been messing around with a number of men. SING plays a trick on PIK to avenge her insult to TAN, which, however, further deepens the conflict between TAN and PIK. TAN decides to leave the acrobatic troupe so as to defuse the growing anger against her. FUNG tries to overcome his phobia of heights, hoping that this will help TAN get her confidence back. SZ expresses her love for LAM but is rejected……

episodes.name: Episode 14
episodes.overview: SING goes to confide in FUNG while YEE tries to seek consolation from TAN. SING wonders if LAM is the man who has won TAN’s heart. He is not going to give up on TAN but TAN asks him not to disturb her any more. FUNG and TAN miss each other terribly but just do not have a chance to meet. YEE would like to move out of FUNG’s home but LING persuades her to stay. LING encourages YEE not to give up too early and offers her a lot of advice as to how to win FUNG’s heart. Someone tries to stalk FUNG and YEE during their treasure hunt. LAM is going to join TAN in her stunt performance, which makes SZ incredibly jealous. LAM is furious to see FUNG and TAN together. He warns FUNG to keep away from TAN. TAN refuses to break up with FUNG, which enrages LAM all the more. FUNG goes to watch TAN’s performance. LAM gets distracted and injures himself as he catches sight of FUNG……

episodes.name: Episode 15
episodes.overview: FUNG believes that LAM is aware of where the treasures are hidden. Knowing that the acrobatic troupe runs so smoothly even without him, LAM gets a little upset. TAN persuades LAM to accept SZ’s love. She stresses that she only regards him as her brother and LAM seems to have got inspired by her words. KWAN and CHI enlists LAM’s help in the search for the treasures and they promise to offer him significant financial advantages in return. SING and YEE go and stalk FUNG and TAN. Now they are absolutely certain that FUNG and TAN are really an item. Feeling cheated by FUNG and TAN, SING and YEE go and put some laxatives into the pair’s food so as to vent their anger but they turn out to be the ones who suffer at the end. FUNG finds out where the treasures are hidden but LAM doubts whether it is possible to unlock them with the two eggs. LAM gets attacked and FUNG tries to save him immediately……

episodes.name: Episode 16
episodes.overview: Except a gold Buddha statue, there is nothing inside the cave. LAM soon realizes this is not really where the treasures are hidden. MAN is shocked to learn that there is someone else inside the cave. As LAM is about to attack MAN, FUNG manages to get out of the trap. LAM breaks the Buddha statue accidentally while he is trying to escape from the cave. MAN is found lying unconscious on the ground. FUNG tries to repair the broken statue and is surprised to find some words on it, which read “Repent before it’s too late”. KWAN suspects that LAM has gone to explore the treasures without letting him know. FUNG opens the golden egg with TAN’s necklace and finds a golden cup inside. LAM decides to gang up with SHUN. He pretends to pass the silver egg to MAN and will try to steal the golden egg from him when the chance comes up. A fire breaks out in MAN’s office, during which MAN trips over and loses his consciousness……

episodes.name: Episode 17
episodes.overview: KWAN is put on the Police’s wanted list while CHI has left the zoo. YEE blames TAN for stealing her man and says TAN is too hypocritical to be her friend. YEE and SING move out of FUNG’s home after giving him a severe telling-off. HUNG needs FUNG to return to the States but FUNG insists on staying for the treasure hunt. FUNG goes to MAN’s office to look for the cause of the fire. He suspects that LAM has something to do with the incident. LAM is going to leave the acrobatic troupe but he finally promises to stay at the troupe mates’ request. Knowing that FUNG and YEE are only friends, LING invites TAN to dinner at her house. LING is not happy with TAN’s backgrounds and HUNG suggests TAN should give up on FUNG for his sake. Having heard what LING and HUNG have said, TAN feels a deep sense of inferiority towards FUNG……

episodes.name: Episode 18
episodes.overview: LAM knows that FUNG has seen through him already. He is going to kill FUNG but is stopped by SHUN. TAN gets knocked down by a vehicle. FUNG fears that someone is trying to harm her. LAM threatens to kill TAN and Granny SAM unless FUNG promises to break up with TAN. YEE and SING are in love with each other but both of them are just too proud to take a further step. SING finally plucks up his courage to express his love for YEE and the pair have started dating ever since then. Not wanting to be an object of ridicule, YEE and SING decide to keep their relationship secret. FUNG points out that LAM was trying to hurt TAN during the practice but TAN insists that it was LAM who saved her life. FUNG is blamed for his malicious allegation against LAM. LAM admits to FUNG that he did have an intention to hurt TAN and he meant to injure himself so that he can frame FUNG for assault. TAN is angry with FUNG and asks to break up with him……

episodes.name: Episode 19
episodes.overview: HUNG explains to FUNG that the Tiger painting used to belong to the Eldest Tiger, his adoptive father, and was given to him before the man passed away. HUNG is disappointed for not being able to unlock the mystery of the Tiger painting. FUNG works out the message hidden in the painting, from which he can finally deduce the location of the treasures. HUNG needs FUNG to return the treasures, if found, to the government, with which SHUN does not agree. SHUN is so unhappy with HUNG that he gives him a punch before leaving the spot. KWAN, LAM and SHUN gang up together in the hunt for the treasures. KWAN has kidnapped TAN and FUNG’s parents. One of KWAN’s assistants is going to rape TAN but LAM manages to save her in the nick of time. LAM tries to kiss TAN but she pushes him off and bites him hard until he releases her. KWAN has kidnapped HUNG as well……

episodes.name: Episode 20
episodes.overview: FUNG is left in a coma after the explosion. TAN is so worried about him that she gives him cardiopulmonary resuscitation at once. FUNG finally comes around from unconsciousness. FUNG, TAN, YEE and SING have found the real treasures left by the Ten Tigers. All of them are enraptured by the gleam of the treasures. FUNG is the first one who has his mind back and has not succumbed to temptation. FUNG has finally found the bronze goat. In the meantime, KWAN, LAM and SHUN have also come along. FUNG detonates the silver egg and seizes the chance to rescue HUNG in the confusion. Driven by a sense of guilt and regret, SHUN tries to shield HUNG from a gunshot and is left injured. KWAN is crushed to death by piles of gold. LAM captures TAN and holds her hostage with a knife...

candidates.name: I Was Bitten
candidates.overview: The subtitle "... And Somehow Survived" could accompany this series that goes around the world to tell the stories of victims of near-fatal animal bites, stories bolstered with actual photos and video footage. From the arid deserts of the Southwestern United States to the lethal waters of Australia, I Was Bitten features victims of the most intense, gruesome, near fatal bites from around the world - with actual photo and video footage. Both the victims and the doctors involved in saving them are interviewed, and the the fascinating science behind the bite is explored, which reveals the devastating aftermath of lethal toxins in the human body.

selected.name: Señorita 89
selected.overview: A period drama set in the dark glamour of 1980s Mexico following the contestants training for the country’s Miss Mexico pageant as they vie not only to win - but to make it to the final contest alive.

episodes.name: Elena
episodes.overview: A party is in full swing on the night before the grand finale of the beauty pageant when a body falls from a terrace and into the path of a woman called Elena.

episodes.name: Jocelyn
episodes.overview: Jocelyn learns that her sister has disappeared. The press takes interest, and Nora recruits Dolores, Ángeles and Jocelyn to sneak into a movie set in a cabin in the woods.

episodes.name: Ángeles
episodes.overview: The girls try to keep up appearances. They stick to their version of what happened, corroborated by all those involved in the night's events. But the Hidalgos become suspicious.

episodes.name: Isabel
episodes.overview: Raúl intimidates the girls while Elena hides the tape in Hidalgo's office, Isabel vies for Iriarte's sponsorship, and Jocelyn tries to get to her sister.

episodes.name: Luisa
episodes.overview: Valenzuela's widow appears on television, asking for help. A famous band visit La Encantada and choose five girls for their video. Jocelyn runs away to find her sister.

episodes.name: Concepción
episodes.overview: The girls who tried to escape by going to the party with Nando are caught, Jocelyn and Dolores are taken to Concepción, and Antonio tells Ángeles he wants to help them.

episodes.name: Dolores

selected.name: The White Queen
selected.overview: Set against the backdrop of the Wars of the Roses, the series is the story of the women caught up in the protracted conflict for the throne of England.

episodes.name: In Love With The King
episodes.overview: After meeting beautiful widow Elizabeth Woodville, young King Edward IV must choose between love and loyalty. Will a country divided by war and a court divided by jealousy be destroyed by a woman many consider a witch?

episodes.name: The Price of Power
episodes.overview: After Elizabeth's coronation, an extravagant display designed to silence critics of their marriage, Edward needs a son to secure his reign. But tensions at court escalate into outright war and Edward must fight those closest to him to retain his crown. Elizabeth faces devastating loss as the full force of Warwick's hatred is revealed.

episodes.name: The Storm
episodes.overview: Desperate to further her son's claim to the throne, Margaret Beaufort joins Warwick's rebellion against Edward. The rebellion fails and the traitors must run for their lives. Jasper Tudor escapes into exile, while Warwick and George sail for France. Elizabeth and Jacquetta turn to witchcraft to stop them, but it is Isabel who is punished.

episodes.name: The Bad Queen
episodes.overview: Exiled in France, Warwick still plots to control the crown. His youngest daughter Anne is used to make an unexpected alliance, giving him command of a huge army. When Warwick lands in England, Edward must decide whether to fight or run. Terrified, Elizabeth escapes to sanctuary, not knowing if her husband is alive or dead. She gives birth to a longed-for son, but is in fear for her life as Warwick enters London.

episodes.name: War At First Hand
episodes.overview: Lancaster is restored to the throne, with Warwick in control. But rumours that Edward is returning with an army unsettle the court. Anne and Margaret of Anjou sail from France, uncertain they will reach Warwick in time to win. Divided families face each other across the battlefield. Can Elizabeth's witchcraft save her husband, or will Warwick triumph? As many fall in the battle, everyone's fortunes change forever.

episodes.name: Love and Death
episodes.overview: The crown is secure, but there is no peace at court. Elizabeth suffers more emotional turmoil as she loses those closest to her. Margaret Beaufort plans a political marriage to bring Henry home from exile - but has she met her match in Lord Stanley? Anne's marriage made her a traitor, so she is handed into George's care. His motives for keeping her away from court are questioned by Richard, who fears for Anne's safety.

episodes.name: Poison and Malmsey Wine
episodes.overview: George's anger at losing the Warwick inheritance and his failure to capture the crown resurfaces, with horrific consequences. As the court divides, George openly accuses Elizabeth of witchcraft and Edward of murder. This is treason, and Edward must condemn his own brother to death. Elizabeth finally has revenge on those who killed her father, but it does not bring her comfort.

episodes.name: Long Live The King
episodes.overview: After years of peace an untimely death once again engulfs Elizabeth in a fight for the throne. Trapped in sanctuary and threatened by those closest to her, Elizabeth is forced into an alliance with Margaret Beaufort. Suspicion and doubt poison the court, turning friends into enemies and family into murderers.

episodes.name: The Princes in the Tower
episodes.overview: The future of the princes in the Tower is in Richard's hands: they are a threat to his reign but also to Margaret's hopes of seeing her son Henry Tudor on the throne. As Margaret plots the boys' removal, Anne is tormented by fears she has unwittingly sealed the princes' fate. Elizabeth, in sanctuary, is horrified to realise she has made a pact with her enemies and turns to witchcraft to punish the guilty.

episodes.name: The Final Battle
episodes.overview: Princess Elizabeth's engagement to Henry Tudor threatens to divide court loyalties. Richard knows he can no longer avoid the battle which will decide his fate as king. Margaret does not know whose side her husband will support, and fears for her son. As the final battle for the crown draws near, Elizabeth continues to plot to put her daughter on the throne whatever the outcome.

1.name: Miniseries
1.overview: The White Queen is a stunningly rich tale of love and loss, seduction and deception, betrayal and murder, vibrantly woven through the stories of three different yet equally driven women, in their quest for power as they manipulate behind the scenes of history – Elizabeth Woodville, Margaret Beaufort and Anne Neville. The year is 1464 and England has been at war for nine years battling over who is the rightful King of England – it is a war between two sides of the same family, The House of York and The House of Lancaster.

selected.name: Becoming Elizabeth
selected.overview: The fascinating story of the early life of England’s most iconic Queen, Elizabeth Tudor, an orphaned teenager who became embroiled in the political and sexual politics of the English court on her journey to obtain the crown.

episodes.name: Keep Your Knife Bright
episodes.overview: Following the death of Henry VIII, his three children; Mary, Elizabeth and Edward are now pawns in a dangerous game as the English court is plunged into a race for control of the new England they find themselves in.

episodes.name: You Cannot Keep the Birds From Flying Over Your Head
episodes.overview: Christmas at court, and a controversial masque leaves Protestant Edward and Catholic Mary at odds. Elizabeth finds herself in the middle as Mary demands she come live with her.

episodes.name: Either Learn or Be Silent
episodes.overview: The Lord Protector’s plan for peace between the siblings only causes Catherine and Thomas to accelerate their own, using Elizabeth’s 15th birthday as cover.

episodes.name: Lighten Our Darkness
episodes.overview: Having been sent away from Catherine and Thomas' household, Elizabeth is amongst strangers in the house of Kat's brother-in-law Antony Denny, and terrified of anyone finding out her secrets from Chelsea Place.

episodes.name: Necessity Compels Me to Plague You
episodes.overview: Elizabeth is determined to not fall into the same traps she did when last she was at Chelsea. While the court has been rocked by Mary’s defiance, the Lord Somerset is still more concerned with the war in Scotland.

episodes.name: What Cannot Be Cured
episodes.overview: Both Elizabeth and Somerset face the consequences of Thomas’ actions, while Mary finds that she is the only family member that the king can now trust.

episodes.name: To Laugh, To Lie, To Flatter, To Face
episodes.overview: There is a new Lord Protector and Mary and Elizabeth both find themselves at the mercy of the new regime and their zealous little brother.

episodes.name: To Death We Must Stoop
episodes.overview: With the king sick, court fears he will be succeeded by one of his sisters, but which sister?

selected.name: The Girl from Plainville
selected.overview: The controversial case of Michelle Carter, who was convicted in 2017 of involuntary manslaughter for encouraging the suicide of her then-boyfriend via texts and phone calls.

episodes.name: Star-Crossed Lovers and Things Like That
episodes.overview: A teen’s death by suicide unearths painful questions for his family and reveals a complicated, mostly virtual relationship with a young woman who may hold the answers.

episodes.name: Turtle
episodes.overview: Conrad and Michelle meet in Florida and discover a connection that will follow them back to their respective towns in Massachusetts; Michelle honors Conrad’s memory while the police review their text exchanges in the months leading up to his passing.

episodes.name: Never Have I Ever
episodes.overview: Assistant District Attorney Katie Rayburn is reluctantly enlisted to pursue possible charges against Michelle; Michelle is torn between a new friend and Conrad.

episodes.name: Can't Fight This Feeling
episodes.overview: As the threat of legal action mounts, Gail and David hire a lawyer to represent their daughter; Co and Lynn struggle with their pasts and Michelle tries to help Coco settle into a new normal.

episodes.name: Mirrorball
episodes.overview: While the prosecution and defense get their strategies in place for trial, Michelle's isolation from her peers pushes her to a breaking point. Michelle and Coco see each other in person for the first time since Florida.

episodes.name: Talking Is Healing
episodes.overview: The trial begins and a new Michelle emerges. The prosecution lays out Michelle's involvement in Coco's death and Lynn Roy takes the stand. Michelle finds help for her eating disorder while Coco dives deeper into his depression.

episodes.name: Teenage Dirtbag
episodes.overview: The defense hopes the testimony of Dr. Breggin will clinch Michelle's acquittal. Co struggles with regret. Coco relies on Michelle to maneuver through his suicidal ideations. Michelle is still haunted by the past, and the verdict is read.

episodes.name: Blank Spaces
episodes.overview: Coco's last day. Michelle struggles with the future. The Carters and Roys both try to find closure after tragedy.

selected.name: Infiniti
selected.overview: The ISS, the International Space Station has gone silent. The crew is in distress. Simultaneously, a decapitated and waxed body is found on a roof in Kazakhstan. Positive identification leaves no room for doubt: the body belongs to an American astronaut currently on a mission on the ISS. A French astronaut, dismissed from the space program, and a Kazakh cop, disowned by his ranking hierarchy, set out to solve this mysterious paradox.

episodes.name: The Tower of Silence
episodes.overview: The ISS, the International Space Station has gone silent. The crew is in distress. Simultaneously, a decapitated and waxed body is found on a roof in Kazakhstan. Positive identification leaves no room for doubt: the body belongs to an American astronaut currently on a mission on the ISS. A French astronaut, dismissed from the space program, and a Kazakh cop, disowned by his ranking hierarchy, set out to solve this mysterious paradox.

episodes.name: The Tower of Babel
episodes.overview: After his latest discoveries, Isaak wonders if he is not pursuing a killer of cosmonauts. Determined to save the crew of the ISS, Anna begins to dream that she will go into space. At the cosmodrome, Emil Durkhov and the other engineers are looking for a way to communicate with the space station.

episodes.name: First Lightning
episodes.overview: Anna and Isaak are on the run with, hot on their heels, Belinski, the head of security. In Baikonur, Fef is convinced that his sister Irina is hiding something about her husband. At the cosmodrome, Mikhaïl and Réva suspect a hack at the origin of the accident. Anna joins the tracking station where Gilgamesh lives.

episodes.name: Black Sun
episodes.overview: Lydia and Réva understand that the American satellite has been hacked from the cosmodrome. Their investigation leads them to the MIR archives. Questioned by Belinksi, Gilgamesh refuses to speak. In the middle of the irradiated zone, Anna and Isaak manage to reach the landing point of the Soyuz.

episodes.name: Thus Spoke Zarathustra
episodes.overview: The International Space Station finally responds: the crew is alive and well. Relieved, Durkov confirms the rescue mission, so Anna prepares for the big departure. Fef and Isaak find the traces of the cosmonaut killer. For her part, Lydia goes through the archives of MIR and ends up finding the anomaly that could explain everything.

episodes.name: Through the Mirror
episodes.overview: Isaak discovers the events that took place aboard the MIR station 25 years earlier and unlocks the secret of the killer's identity. In the damaged station, covered in frost and soon deprived of oxygen, Anna finds part of the crew and tries to bring everyone back to Earth.

candidates.name: The Infinite Worlds of H.G. Wells
candidates.originalName: The Infinite Worlds of H.G. Wells
candidates.overview: Each episode adapts — and sometimes quite radically alters — a short story written by Wells: The New Accelerator, The Queer Story of Brownlow's Newspaper, The Crystal Egg, The Remarkable Case of Davidson's Eyes, The Truth About Pyecraft and The Stolen Bacillus. Each is presented as if it were a 'real' incident that Wells had investigated with his girlfriend, Jane Robbins, and as if it had served as an inspiration for a short story. The flashbacks are to 1893 within the 1946 frame story, near the end of Wells's life, when he is interviewed by a secret military research institute interested in his past exploits.

episodes.name: The New Accelerator
episodes.overview: Scientific discovery can be such a rush. Wrapped around the ongoing plot device of interviews with an elderly H.G. Wells as he recounts fantastical tales he swears are true. Starting with a lab experiment that could revolutionize the world.

episodes.name: Brownlow's Newspaper
episodes.overview: A different sort of time travel tale--What would you do if you knew the future? Would you change that future? Remember Newtons's Third Law and Murphy's.

episodes.name: The Crystal Egg
episodes.overview: A luminous meteorite sparks Wells interest after being brought to his attention by an antiquities dealer and purchased by Ellen using money intended for their night out at the music hall. An investigation brings them to a terrible discovery of its origins and capabilities.

episodes.name: The Remarkable Case of Davidson's Eyes
episodes.overview: After an unauthorized experiment at the college goes awry, young lab assistant Davidson begins seeing visions of a ship at sea and a deserted island. With Jane involved, Wells investigates what went wrong, and another curious case unfolds.

episodes.name: The Truth About Pyecraft

selected.name: Dublin Murders
selected.overview: Two detectives are dispatched to investigate the murder of a young girl on the outskirts of Dublin, but as the case of the missing children intensifies, both are forced to confront the darkness that lies in their past.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: In the summer of 2006 detectives Rob Reilly and Cassie Maddox are sent to investigate a child’s murder. They find a community caught between the old Ireland and the new.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: Despite Rob’s promise to Cassie that they won’t investigate Operation Vestal, they make a dark bargain to keep the secret and carry on working on the cases.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: All of Knocknaree mourns as Katy Devlin is laid to rest, while the pressure on Rob and Cassie mounts as there are still no arrests in the case.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: As Cassie struggles to make sense of Lexie’s life and death, we delve into her own difficult past. Meanwhile, Rob’s past finally yields some results in the Katy investigation.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: Rob makes costly mistakes as Cassie immerses herself in the art of being Lexie.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: When Cassie immerses herself in a undercover assignment, threats both known and unexpected haunt her every living breath. Rob desperately hunts down one last lead.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: Everything comes to a head as Cassie confronts Lexie’s killer and Rob has a breakthrough about Katy’s murder.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: The finale finds Rob and Cassie forced into a face-to-face reunion.As arrests are made, Rob and Cassie both come to profound realisations.
